masters.full_description: الرئيسية استثمر في الأحساء الفرص الاستثمارية الخدمات الرقمية للإرشاد والتوجيه المهني الخدمات الرقمية للإرشاد والتوجيه المهني قطاع التعليم التقنية (EdTech) حجم السوق إجمالي السوق القابل للاستهداف: 2-2.2 مليون مستخدم عدد طلاب التعليم العالي (2030): 1.3-1.5 مليون طالب عدد العاملين (2030): 11-12 مليون شخص نسبة انتشار الإنترنت: 95-100% نسبة التبني الرقمي المدفوع الطلاب: 21-23% العاملين: 15-17% العائد المتوقع من الاستثمار حجم الاستثمار: 40-60 مليون ريال سعودي معدل العائد الداخلي: 11-14% تقريباً تأسيس منصة رقمية شاملة للإرشاد والتوجيه المهني تستهدف الطلاب والمهنيين في المملكة، تقدم خدمات التقييم، الاستشارات، إعداد السيرة الذاتية، والبرامج الإرشادية عبر الإنترنت.تهدف المنصة إلى سد فجوة الإرشاد المهني في السوق المحلي ودعم تطوير رأس المال البشري بما يتماشى مع متطلبات سوق العمل المتغير. الارتباط برؤية 2030 دعم برنامج تنمية القدرات البشرية (HCDP) لتهيئة المواطنين لسوق العمل المحلي والعالمي. مبادرات حكومية مثل سبل (Subol) من صندوق تنمية الموارد البشرية (HRDF) لدعم الإرشاد المهني الرقمي. تعزيز فرص التعلم مدى الحياة وتوفير خدمات الإرشاد للطلاب والباحثين عن عمل. المساهمة في رفع مشاركة المرأة في القوى العاملة، وتحسين المواءمة بين التعليم وسوق العمل. الممكنات دعم حكومي من خلال وزارة التعليم، وزارة الاستثمار وصندوق تنمية الموارد البشرية (HRDF). ارتفاع معدلات الوعي المهني وتزايد الطلب على التدريب المهني والانتقال الوظيفي. بنية رقمية قوية ونسبة انتشار إنترنت تتجاوز 95%. امكانية التكامل مع الجامعات والمؤسسات لتقديم خدمات موجهة (B2C) و (B2B). المواصفات التقنية نوع المشروع: تطبيق ومنصة رقمية للإرشاد والتوجيه المهني. نموذج الاستثمار: مرن- شراكات جامعية (B2B) أو اشتراكات للأفراد (B2C). الفئة المستهدفة: طلاب التعليم الحالي والمهنيين في مختلف القطاعات. قنوات التواصل: تطبيق جوال، منصة ويب متكاملة مع مبادرات حكومية مثل (سبل). الخدمات المقدمة: تقييمات مهنية واختبارات فردية وجماعية. استشارات فردية وجماعية. إعداد السير الذاتية ورسائل التقديم. ورش عمل ودورات توجيهية للطلاب والموظفين. تدريب مهني على المقابلات الشخصية. استثمر في السعودية

masters.full_description: الرئيسية استثمر في الأحساء الفرص الاستثمارية تطوير فنادق 5 نجوم في المنطقة الشرقية تطوير فنادق 5 نجوم في المنطقة الشرقية السياحة وجودة الحياة حجم السوق الرحلات السياحية (2019): 7.5 مليون رحلة الإيرادات السياحية (2019): 15.7 مليار ريال متوسط إنفاق الزائر: 2,535 ريال معدل إشغال الفنادق: 65% العائد المتوقع من الاستثمار حجم الاستثمار: 40 – 60 مليون ريال سعودي معدل العائد الداخلي : 11% – 14% تقريباً إنشاء وتطوير منتجع فاخر من فئة 5 نجوم، بطاقة استيعابية 300-400 غرفة، لتلبية الطلب المتنامي على السياحة الداخلية والدولية، وتعزيز مكانة المملكة كوجهة عالمية مميزة. الارتباط برؤية 2030 رفع الطاقة الاستيعابية لتحقيق مستهدف 100 مليون زيارة سنويًا بحلول 2030. تعزيز البنية التحتية السياحية وتسهيل الحصول على التأشيرات السياحية. دعم مشاريع جودة الحياة والتنمية (مثل موسم الشرقية، المهرجانات السياحية، والمراكز الثقافية مثل إثراء). الممكنات منظومة متكاملة يقودها وزارة السياحة (صندوق التنمية السياحية، الهيئة السعودية للسياحة، ووزارة الاستثمار) لدعم المستثمرين. مشاريع تطوير البنية التحتية والطرق التي تربط المنطقة الشرقية ببقية مدن المملكة. تسهيلات التأشيرات السياحية وزيادة الجاذبية الدولية للمنطقة الشرقية. المواصفات التقنية نوع المشروع: منتجع فاخر 5 نجوم. الطاقة الاستيعابية: 300–400 مفتاح (غرفة/جناح). الموقع: المنطقة الشرقية – وجهات ثقافية وتراثية (قصر إبراهيم، بيت البيعة، مدرسة الأمراء) + ترفيهية (موسم الشرقية، المهرجانات، المولات الكبرى). نموذج الاستثمار: خيارات متعددة (تأجير، مشاركة إيرادات، أو ملكية كاملة). استثمر في السعودية

masters.full_description: الرئيسية استثمر في الأحساء الفرص الاستثمارية مستشفيات الأمومة والأطفال مستشفيات الأمومة والأطفال قطاع الخدمات الصحية حجم السوق معدل النمو: +8% سنويًا السوق المحلي: نمو من 1 مليار دولار (2022) إلى 8.1 مليار (2030) العائد المتوقع من الاستثمار حجم الاستثمار: 300–500 مليون ريال معدل العائد الداخلي : 5%–15% تصميم وبناء وتشغيل وصيانة مستشفى للولادة والأطفال، وتقديم الخدمات في طب الأطفال وأمراض النساء والولادة. الارتباط برؤية 2030 تخصيص الرعاية الصحية: هدف زيادة التخصيص من 25% إلى 35% بحلول 2030. نظام رعاية الطفل والأمومة: تطوير نظام رعاية متخصص حول رعاية الطفل والأمومة. التحول الصحي: التركيز على تحسين جودة الرعاية للحمل والولادة ورعاية الأطفال حديثي الولادة. الممكنات سهولة الحصول على التمويل: تقييم 50 من 100 في مؤشر سهولة الحصول على الائتمان. النظام الصحي المتطور: أكبر ميزانية رعاية صحية في منطقة الشرق الأوسط وشمال أفريقيا (36.7 مليار دولار في 2022). البنية التحتية المتطورة: مؤشر الأداء اللوجستي 3.2 من 5. شبكة مستشفيات موجودة: 25 مستشفى للنساء والولادة/الأطفال عبر المملكة. إعفاء ضريبي: حتى 50% على رواتب الموظفين السعوديين وتكاليف التدريب لمدة 10 سنوات. تغطية صندوق تنمية الموارد البشرية: 30-50% من الرواتب الشهرية للموظفين السعوديين لمدة سنتين. برامج التدريب: برامج التدريب أثناء العمل للمواطنين السعوديين تحت برنامج تمهير. المواصفات التقنية مساحة المنشأة: 5,000–8,500 متر مربع. عدد الأسرّة: 150–250 سرير (للمنشأة الواحدة). استثمر في السعودية

masters.full_description: الرئيسية استثمر في الأحساء الفرص الاستثمارية الخدمات الطبية للمدارس الخدمات الطبية للمدارس قطاع التعليم حجم السوق عدد الطلاب في التعليم العالي(2022): 5.8 - 6.2 مليون عدد الطلاب في التعليم العالي(2030): 6.6 - 7.6 مليون الكـــوادر الطبية (2022): 5 آلاف ممرضة الكـــوادر الطبية (2030): 8 آلاف العائد المتوقع من الاستثمار حجم الاستثمار : يختلف حسب نطاق الخدمات معدل العائد الداخلي: + 250% زيادة في الحاجة للكوادر الطبية حتى 2030 تقديم خدمات طبية شاملة داخل المدارس (طلاب، معلمين، كوادر مساندة) تشمل الرعاية الطارئة، متابعة الأمراض المزمنة، التوعية الصحية، والتنسيق مع الأسر لتحسين صحة المجتمع المدرسي. الارتباط برؤية 2030 برنامج التحول الصحي: تعزيز الوقاية والكشف المبكر داخل المدارس. شراكات بين وزارتي الصحة والتعليم عبر مبادرات Healthy Living Program – School (Health Awareness). رفع الوعي الصحي والسلوكيات الإيجابية لدى الطلاب وأسرهم. الممكنات دعم حكومي من وزارة الصحة + وزارة التعليم. برامج ومبادرات وطنية. شركات متخصصة تقدم عيادات متنقلة وخدمات متكاملة داخل المدارس. المواصفات التقنية خدمات أساسية: رعاية طارئة، متابعة الأمراض المزمنة، التثقيف الصحي، مشاركة الأسرة. عيادات مدرسية مُدمجة + عيادات متنقلة حسب الحاجة. حلول تقنية لمتابعة الحالات والتواصل مع الأسر والجهات الصحية. استثمر في السعودية

masters.full_description: الرئيسية استثمر في الأحساء الفرص الاستثمارية تطوير مراكز الرعاية الصحية الأولية تطوير مراكز الرعاية الصحية الأولية قطاع الخدمات الصحية حجم السوق معدل النمو السنوي: 4.14% سنويًا حجم السوق (2022): 20 مليار ريال سعودي حجم السوق المتوقع (2030): 28 مليار ريال سعودي العائد المتوقع من الاستثمار حجم الاستثمار : 5 - 20 مليون ريال سعودي معدل العائد الداخلي: 10 - 20 % تطوير مراکز الرعایة الصحیة الأولیة الحالیة من خلال تجدید المبانی، تحسین الخدمات، تطویر القوی العاملة وتقدیم الخدمات السریریة. الارتباط برؤية 2030 برنامج التحول الصحي: التركيز على الرعاية المتكاملة والانتقال من الرعاية المستشفوية إلى الرعاية المجتمعية. الوقاية والرعاية المزمنة: الرعاية الأولية محور أساسي في نموذج الرعاية الجديد "البقاء بصحة جيدة" و "الرعاية المزمنة". جودة الخدمات: استهداف 4 زيارات للشخص الواحد سنويًا متماشيًا مع المؤشرات العالمية. الممكنات سهولة الحصول على التمويل. الأجور التنافسية إقليمياً. النظام الصحي المتقدم. البنية التحتية المتطورة. المواصفات التقنية مساحة المنشأة: 1,000-4,000 متر مربع. الطاقة الاستيعابية: 10,000-50,000 زيارة سنوية. استثمر في السعودية

masters.full_description: الرئيسية استثمر في الأحساء الفرص الاستثمارية مراكز التدريب التقني والمهني في السياحة والضيافة مراكز التدريب التقني والمهني في السياحة والضيافة قطاع التعليم حجم السوق الزيارات: 100 مليون زيارة بحلول 2023 الإنفاق السياحي (2015): 131 مليار ريال الإنفاق السياحي (2023): 455 مليار ريال حاجة العمالة المتوقعة حتى 2030 : 500-475 الف عامل العائد المتوقع من الاستثمار حجم الاستثمار : 50-40 مليون ريال مساهمة الناتج المحلي: 10-5.3% بحلول 2023 إنشاء وتطوير مراكز تدريب سياحي وفندقي لتأهيل الكوادر الوطنية عبر برامج تعليمية معتمدة دوليا، تلبي احتياجات سوق العمل وتدعم مستهدفات رؤية 2030. الارتباط برؤية 2030 رفع مساهمة السياحة في الناتج المحلي من 5.3% (في 2022) إلى أكثر من 10% بحلول 2030. دعم مشاريع السياحة العملاقة (القدية، البحر الأحمر، العلا، نيوم) من خلال توفير كوادر مؤهلة. تمكين الشباب السعودي عبر التدريب التقني والمهني المعتمد دولياً. جذب الاستثمارات الخاصة بدعم صندوق التنمية السياحية. الممكنات تسهيلات تمويلية من صندوق التنمية السياحية. دعم حكومي مباشر عبر وزارة السياحة،والمؤسسة العامة للتدريب التقني والمهني. تسهيل دخول السياح عبر سياسات التأشيرات. فرص شراكات استراتيجية مع معاهد تدريب عالمية. المواصفات التقنية الطاقة الاستيعابية: 1,000 متدرب لكل مركز. برامج تدريبية معتمدة محليا ودوليا. بنية تحتية تعليمية متطورة بمرافق منفصلة للذكور والإناث. استثمر في السعودية

The project aims to establish a treatment center mainly for hazardous industrial waste across Al Ahsa cluster.

The global industrial waste management market was valued at 
USD 791.14B in 2020. It is estimated to expand at a CAGR of 
10.4% from 2021 to 2031 

The global industrial waste management market is expected to 
cross the value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of the 
overall waste generated across the globe

The operation would mainly require a continuous input of hazardous 
industrial waste from private waste collectors. This opportunity also 
receives waste from other streams such as agricultural, healthcare 
and ELV waste.
The historic and projected growth in industrial sector as 
part of the KSA transformation requires innovative 
solutions for treatment of hazardous industrial waste
The drive to increase private sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers for 
formulation of the opportunity
The need to modernize waste management sector in 
the Kingdom is a key driver to attracting investors and 
operators

The project aims to establish a treatment center mainly for hazardous industrial waste across Al Ahsa cluster.

The global industrial waste management market was valued at 
USD 791.14B in 2020. It is estimated to expand at a CAGR of 
10.4% from 2021 to 2031 

The global industrial waste management market is expected to 
cross the value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of the 
overall waste generated across the globe

The operation would mainly require a continuous input of hazardous 
industrial waste from private waste collectors. This opportunity also 
receives waste from other streams such as agricultural, healthcare 
and ELV waste.
The historic and projected growth in industrial sector as 
part of the KSA transformation requires innovative 
solutions for treatment of hazardous industrial waste
The drive to increase private sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers for 
formulation of the opportunity
The need to modernize waste management sector in 
the Kingdom is a key driver to attracting investors and 
operators 
* CAGR
M USD 

As KSA continues to expand the industrial sector as part of Vision 2030 
the project enables a hazardous industrial waste operator to capitalize 
on a growing segment on Saudi Arabia's economy

The opportunity allows a potential investor to deliver a greenfield project 
with no constraints from legacy infrastructure in a developing sector 
enabling a full use of best-in-class operational and technical solutions

Expected Investment size: 152M USD*

Plant capacity: 126,996 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 7.79 years

GDP Impact: 749M USD

Location (Region): Al Ahsa Cluster

masters.full_description:
The opportunity aims to operate a healthcare waste treatment infrastructure across all Al Ahsa cluster.

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has increased to 2.6 
M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue of USD 
12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a CAGR of 6.9% during 
the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of reusable 
surgical products and rising awareness programs for medical waste 
management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided from 
public and private healthcare providers and transported to the 
facilities through waste collection and transfer operators in Al 
Ahsa Cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare sector are 
increasing the demand for healthcare waste management 
services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and further 
expansion of Al Ahsa are additional demand drivers and 
are projected to increase in the future

Drive to increase public sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers for 
formulation of the opportunity
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 1M USD*

Plant capacity: 3,500 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 6.83 years

GDP Impact: 40M USD

Location (Region): Al Ahsa Cluster

Al Ahsa’s population is expected to continue to grow over the next few 
decades, which can potentially generate significant demand for the 
project

The investment opportunity focusses on creating waste treatment 
infrastructure, which provides a level of assurance while also offering 
attractive returns to potential investors

waste treatment value chain


uplift in waste treatment solutions

by the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase 
private sector participation require innovative, 
and sustainable solutions in KSA


coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life 
vehicle treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market


management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant authorities

masters.full_description: News Return to Media Center 01/04/2026 Previous Next MOMAH and NCP Launch EOI to Municipal Food Safety Labs Across Five Municipalities in Saudi Arabia Page Image Developing advanced food safety labs to enhance testing, ensure quality, and protect public health in line with Vision 2030. Page Content Riyadh, April 2026 , the Ministry of Municipalities and Housing (MOMAH) and the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), have announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) stage for the Municipal Food Safety Labs Operation Project under a PPP framework (Equip-Operate-Maintain-Transfer) for a contract duration of 5 years, inviting local, regional, and global companies with experience in lab operations to participate and submit their bids. The project scope includes equipping, operating, and maintaining food safety labs across five municipalities, including Hafr Al Batin, Northern Borders, Tabuk, Qassim, and Al Ahsa. The project aims to upgrade lab equipment, expand chemical and microbiological testing capacity for food and water products, ensure testing accuracy to support the lab compliance value chain, and facilitate ongoing knowledge transfer and end-of-contract handover to the respective municipalities. The Municipal Food Safety Labs Operation Project seeks to boost public health and safety standards for the Kingdom's citizens and residents in line with the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030, besides developing the municipal monitoring ecosystem, optimizing food and water testing, and empowering the private sector to run operations as per global best practices. Once completed, the project will enhance food safety in the Kingdom, enable sustainable growth across targeted regions by creating unique investment opportunities for the private sector, and improve the efficiency of government spending through the PPP model, playing a key role in elevating the quality of municipal services being offered to citizens and residents. Local and international investors, financial institutions, and operators are invited to visit the NCP website at www.investors.ncp​.gov.sa for more information about the project and to request the EOI document. Interested investors should submit their EOI by 15 April 2026 at 11:59 PM KSA time.​ ​ Share | Print

target_after_json.full_description: News Return to Media Center 01/04/2026 Previous Next MOMAH and NCP Launch EOI to Municipal Food Safety Labs Across Five Municipalities in Saudi Arabia Page Image Developing advanced food safety labs to enhance testing, ensure quality, and protect public health in line with Vision 2030. Page Content Riyadh, April 2026 , the Ministry of Municipalities and Housing (MOMAH) and the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), have announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) stage for the Municipal Food Safety Labs Operation Project under a PPP framework (Equip-Operate-Maintain-Transfer) for a contract duration of 5 years, inviting local, regional, and global companies with experience in lab operations to participate and submit their bids. The project scope includes equipping, operating, and maintaining food safety labs across five municipalities, including Hafr Al Batin, Northern Borders, Tabuk, Qassim, and Al Ahsa. The project aims to upgrade lab equipment, expand chemical and microbiological testing capacity for food and water products, ensure testing accuracy to support the lab compliance value chain, and facilitate ongoing knowledge transfer and end-of-contract handover to the respective municipalities. The Municipal Food Safety Labs Operation Project seeks to boost public health and safety standards for the Kingdom's citizens and residents in line with the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030, besides developing the municipal monitoring ecosystem, optimizing food and water testing, and empowering the private sector to run operations as per global best practices. Once completed, the project will enhance food safety in the Kingdom, enable sustainable growth across targeted regions by creating unique investment opportunities for the private sector, and improve the efficiency of government spending through the PPP model, playing a key role in elevating the quality of municipal services being offered to citizens and residents. Local and international investors, financial institutions, and operators are invited to visit the NCP website at www.investors.ncp​.gov.sa for more information about the project and to request the EOI document. Interested investors should submit their EOI by 15 April 2026 at 11:59 PM KSA time.​ ​ Share | Print

raw_data_json.raw_text: الرئيسية استثمر في الأحساء الفرص الاستثمارية الخدمات الرقمية للإرشاد والتوجيه المهني الخدمات الرقمية للإرشاد والتوجيه المهني قطاع التعليم التقنية (EdTech) حجم السوق إجمالي السوق القابل للاستهداف: 2-2.2 مليون مستخدم عدد طلاب التعليم العالي (2030): 1.3-1.5 مليون طالب عدد العاملين (2030): 11-12 مليون شخص نسبة انتشار الإنترنت: 95-100% نسبة التبني الرقمي المدفوع الطلاب: 21-23% العاملين: 15-17% العائد المتوقع من الاستثمار حجم الاستثمار: 40-60 مليون ريال سعودي معدل العائد الداخلي: 11-14% تقريباً تأسيس منصة رقمية شاملة للإرشاد والتوجيه المهني تستهدف الطلاب والمهنيين في المملكة، تقدم خدمات التقييم، الاستشارات، إعداد السيرة الذاتية، والبرامج الإرشادية عبر الإنترنت.تهدف المنصة إلى سد فجوة الإرشاد المهني في السوق المحلي ودعم تطوير رأس المال البشري بما يتماشى مع متطلبات سوق العمل المتغير. الارتباط برؤية 2030 دعم برنامج تنمية القدرات البشرية (HCDP) لتهيئة المواطنين لسوق العمل المحلي والعالمي. مبادرات حكومية مثل سبل (Subol) من صندوق تنمية الموارد البشرية (HRDF) لدعم الإرشاد المهني الرقمي. تعزيز فرص التعلم مدى الحياة وتوفير خدمات الإرشاد للطلاب والباحثين عن عمل. المساهمة في رفع مشاركة المرأة في القوى العاملة، وتحسين المواءمة بين التعليم وسوق العمل. الممكنات دعم حكومي من خلال وزارة التعليم، وزارة الاستثمار وصندوق تنمية الموارد البشرية (HRDF). ارتفاع معدلات الوعي المهني وتزايد الطلب على التدريب المهني والانتقال الوظيفي. بنية رقمية قوية ونسبة انتشار إنترنت تتجاوز 95%. امكانية التكامل مع الجامعات والمؤسسات لتقديم خدمات موجهة (B2C) و (B2B). المواصفات التقنية نوع المشروع: تطبيق ومنصة رقمية للإرشاد والتوجيه المهني. نموذج الاستثمار: مرن- شراكات جامعية (B2B) أو اشتراكات للأفراد (B2C). الفئة المستهدفة: طلاب التعليم الحالي والمهنيين في مختلف القطاعات. قنوات التواصل: تطبيق جوال، منصة ويب متكاملة مع مبادرات حكومية مثل (سبل). الخدمات المقدمة: تقييمات مهنية واختبارات فردية وجماعية. استشارات فردية وجماعية. إعداد السير الذاتية ورسائل التقديم. ورش عمل ودورات توجيهية للطلاب والموظفين. تدريب مهني على المقابلات الشخصية. استثمر في السعودية

raw_data_json.raw_text: الرئيسية استثمر في الأحساء الفرص الاستثمارية تطوير فنادق 5 نجوم في المنطقة الشرقية تطوير فنادق 5 نجوم في المنطقة الشرقية السياحة وجودة الحياة حجم السوق الرحلات السياحية (2019): 7.5 مليون رحلة الإيرادات السياحية (2019): 15.7 مليار ريال متوسط إنفاق الزائر: 2,535 ريال معدل إشغال الفنادق: 65% العائد المتوقع من الاستثمار حجم الاستثمار: 40 – 60 مليون ريال سعودي معدل العائد الداخلي : 11% – 14% تقريباً إنشاء وتطوير منتجع فاخر من فئة 5 نجوم، بطاقة استيعابية 300-400 غرفة، لتلبية الطلب المتنامي على السياحة الداخلية والدولية، وتعزيز مكانة المملكة كوجهة عالمية مميزة. الارتباط برؤية 2030 رفع الطاقة الاستيعابية لتحقيق مستهدف 100 مليون زيارة سنويًا بحلول 2030. تعزيز البنية التحتية السياحية وتسهيل الحصول على التأشيرات السياحية. دعم مشاريع جودة الحياة والتنمية (مثل موسم الشرقية، المهرجانات السياحية، والمراكز الثقافية مثل إثراء). الممكنات منظومة متكاملة يقودها وزارة السياحة (صندوق التنمية السياحية، الهيئة السعودية للسياحة، ووزارة الاستثمار) لدعم المستثمرين. مشاريع تطوير البنية التحتية والطرق التي تربط المنطقة الشرقية ببقية مدن المملكة. تسهيلات التأشيرات السياحية وزيادة الجاذبية الدولية للمنطقة الشرقية. المواصفات التقنية نوع المشروع: منتجع فاخر 5 نجوم. الطاقة الاستيعابية: 300–400 مفتاح (غرفة/جناح). الموقع: المنطقة الشرقية – وجهات ثقافية وتراثية (قصر إبراهيم، بيت البيعة، مدرسة الأمراء) + ترفيهية (موسم الشرقية، المهرجانات، المولات الكبرى). نموذج الاستثمار: خيارات متعددة (تأجير، مشاركة إيرادات، أو ملكية كاملة). استثمر في السعودية

raw_data_json.raw_text: الرئيسية استثمر في الأحساء الفرص الاستثمارية مستشفيات الأمومة والأطفال مستشفيات الأمومة والأطفال قطاع الخدمات الصحية حجم السوق معدل النمو: +8% سنويًا السوق المحلي: نمو من 1 مليار دولار (2022) إلى 8.1 مليار (2030) العائد المتوقع من الاستثمار حجم الاستثمار: 300–500 مليون ريال معدل العائد الداخلي : 5%–15% تصميم وبناء وتشغيل وصيانة مستشفى للولادة والأطفال، وتقديم الخدمات في طب الأطفال وأمراض النساء والولادة. الارتباط برؤية 2030 تخصيص الرعاية الصحية: هدف زيادة التخصيص من 25% إلى 35% بحلول 2030. نظام رعاية الطفل والأمومة: تطوير نظام رعاية متخصص حول رعاية الطفل والأمومة. التحول الصحي: التركيز على تحسين جودة الرعاية للحمل والولادة ورعاية الأطفال حديثي الولادة. الممكنات سهولة الحصول على التمويل: تقييم 50 من 100 في مؤشر سهولة الحصول على الائتمان. النظام الصحي المتطور: أكبر ميزانية رعاية صحية في منطقة الشرق الأوسط وشمال أفريقيا (36.7 مليار دولار في 2022). البنية التحتية المتطورة: مؤشر الأداء اللوجستي 3.2 من 5. شبكة مستشفيات موجودة: 25 مستشفى للنساء والولادة/الأطفال عبر المملكة. إعفاء ضريبي: حتى 50% على رواتب الموظفين السعوديين وتكاليف التدريب لمدة 10 سنوات. تغطية صندوق تنمية الموارد البشرية: 30-50% من الرواتب الشهرية للموظفين السعوديين لمدة سنتين. برامج التدريب: برامج التدريب أثناء العمل للمواطنين السعوديين تحت برنامج تمهير. المواصفات التقنية مساحة المنشأة: 5,000–8,500 متر مربع. عدد الأسرّة: 150–250 سرير (للمنشأة الواحدة). استثمر في السعودية

raw_data_json.description: This opportunity sets up an Equestrian Training Academy inside public schools in the Riyadh region. It will build and run riding arenas, stables, and training programs for 250–400 trainees each year. Location: Al Iskan district, Riyadh city, on a site of more than 12,000 m², using land and buildings already provided by the Ministry of Education. It is the first academy of its kind inside a public school, helping promote horse riding as part of Saudi heritage.

raw_data_json.description:
The project aims to establish a treatment facility for non-hazardous industrial waste across Yanbu cluster.

The global industrial waste management market was valued at 
USD 791.14B in 2020. It is estimated to expand at a CAGR of 
10.4% from 2021 to 2031 

The global industrial waste management market is expected 
to cross the value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of 
the overall waste generated across the globe

The operation would require a continuous input of non-
hazardous industrial waste from private waste collectors
The historic and projected growth in industrial 
sector as part of the KSA transformation requires 
innovative solutions for treatment of industrial 
waste
The drive to increase private sector participation 
and competitiveness in the economy are further 
drivers for formulation of the opportunity
The need to modernize waste management sector 
in the Kingdom is a key driver to attracting 
investors and operators 
* CAGR
M USD 

As KSA continues to expand the industrial sector as part of 
Vision 2030 the project enables the industrial waste operator 
to capitalize on a growing segment on Saudi Arabia's 
economy

The opportunity allows a potential investor to deliver a 
greenfield project with no constraints from legacy 
infrastructure in a developing sector enabling a full use of 
best-in-class operational and technical solutions

Expected Investment size: 13M USD*

Plant capacity: 46,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 19.56%

Payback period: 4.78 years

GDP Impact: 347M USD

Location (Region): Yanbu Cluster

raw_data_json.description:
The opportunity aims to operate a healthcare waste treatment infrastructure across all Yanbu cluster.

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has 
increased to 2.6 M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue 
of USD 12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a 
CAGR of 6.9% during the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of 
reusable surgical products and rising awareness programs for 
medical waste management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided 
from public and private healthcare providers and 
transported to the facilities through waste collection 
and transfer operators in Yanbu Cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare 
sector are increasing the demand for healthcare 
waste management services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and 
further expansion of Yanbu are additional demand 
drivers and are projected to increase in the future

Drive to increase public sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers 
for formulation of the opportunity
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 1M USD*

Plant capacity: 1,500 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 6.83 years

GDP Impact: 24M USD

Location (Region): Yanbu Cluster

Yanbu’s population is expected to continue to grow over the 
next few decades, which can potentially generate significant 
demand for the project

The investment opportunity focusses on creating waste 
treatment infrastructure, which provides a level of assurance 
while also offering attractive returns to potential investors

short_description.raw:
The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste tire treatment facility for the entire Yanbu cluster.

Nearly one billion ELTs are generated worldwide annually, 
constituting more than 2% of the total amount of solid waste, and 
this waste flow is growing dynamically

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life tires 
from producers for processing the waste

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption etc.) 
are increasing tire consumption requiring uplift in 
waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven by 
the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase private 
sector participation require innovative, and 
sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life tire 
treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant authorities 
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 1M USD*

Plant capacity: 2,500 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%







Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic 
drop, reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to 
decline in 2022, with a 2023 still below 2019

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life 
vehicles from producers for processing and transfer along the 
further waste treatment value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption etc.) 
are increasing vehicle consumption requiring uplift 
in waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven 
by the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase 
private sector participation require innovative, and 
sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA 
is expected to generate significant increase in consumption 
over the coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an 
end-of-life vehicle treatment facility operator to enter an 
attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant 
authorities

full_description.raw:
The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste vehicles treatment facility for the entire Tabuk cluster.

Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic 
drop, reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to 
decline in 2022, with a 2023 still below 2019

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life 
vehicles from producers for processing and transfer along the 
further waste treatment value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption etc.) 
are increasing vehicle consumption requiring uplift 
in waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven 
by the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase 
private sector participation require innovative, and 
sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA 
is expected to generate significant increase in consumption 
over the coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an 
end-of-life vehicle treatment facility operator to enter an 
attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant 
authorities 
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 0.8M USD*

Plant capacity: 13,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 45.37%

Payback period: 1.88 years

GDP Impact: 54M USD

Location (Region): Tabuk Cluster

raw_data_json.description:
The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste tire treatment facility for the entire Tabuk cluster.

Nearly one billion ELTs are generated worldwide annually, 
constituting more than 2% of the total amount of solid waste, 
and this waste flow is growing dynamically

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life tires 
from producers for processing the waste

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption etc.) 
are increasing tire consumption requiring uplift in 
waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven 
by the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase 
private sector participation require innovative, and 
sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA 
is expected to generate significant increase in consumption 
over the coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an 
end-of-life tire treatment facility operator to enter an attractive 
market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant 
authorities 
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 0.6M USD*

Plant capacity: 3,800 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 16.09%

Payback period: 5.32 years

GDP Impact: 18M USD

Location (Region): Tabuk Cluster

raw_data_json.description:
The project aims to establish a treatment center mainly for hazardous industrial waste across Taif cluster.

The global industrial waste management market was valued at 
USD 791.14B in 2020. It is estimated to expand at a CAGR of 
10.4% from 2021 to 2031 

The global industrial waste management market is expected to 
cross the value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of the 
overall waste generated across the globe

The operation would mainly require a continuous input of 
hazardous industrial waste from private waste collectors. This 
opportunity also receives waste from other streams such as 
agricultural, healthcare and ELV waste.
The historic and projected growth in industrial 
sector as part of the KSA transformation 
requires innovative solutions for treatment of 
hazardous industrial waste
The drive to increase private sector 
participation and competitiveness in the 
economy are further drivers for formulation of 
the opportunity
The need to modernize waste management 
sector in the Kingdom is a key driver to 
attracting investors and operators 
* CAGR
M USD 

As KSA continues to expand the industrial sector as part of Vision 
2030 the project enables a hazardous industrial waste operator to 
capitalize on a growing segment on Saudi Arabia's economy

The opportunity allows a potential investor to deliver a greenfield 
project with no constraints from legacy infrastructure in a 
developing sector enabling a full use of best-in-class operational 
and technical solutions

Expected Investment size: 26M USD*

Plant capacity: 21,241 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 7.67 years

GDP Impact: 138M USD

Location (Region): Taif Cluster

surgical products and rising awareness programs for medical

transfer operators in Taif Cluster

sector are increasing the demand for healthcare 
waste management services

the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase private 
sector participation require innovative, and 
sustainable solutions in KSA

coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life 
vehicle treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market


management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant authorities

full_description.raw:
The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste vehicles treatment facility for the entire Taif cluster.

Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic 
drop, reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to decline 
in 2022, with a 2023 still below 2019

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life vehicles 
from producers for processing and transfer along the further 
waste treatment value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption etc.) 
are increasing vehicle consumption requiring uplift in 
waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven by 
the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase private 
sector participation require innovative, and 
sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life 
vehicle treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant authorities




Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 8.58 years

The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste tire treatment facility for the entire Taif cluster.

Nearly one billion ELTs are generated worldwide annually, 
constituting more than 2% of the total amount of solid waste, 
and this waste flow is growing dynamically

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life tires 
from producers for processing the waste

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption 
etc.) are increasing tire consumption requiring 
uplift in waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation 
driven by the Vision 2030 and initiatives to 
increase private sector participation require 
innovative, and sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA 
is expected to generate significant increase in consumption 
over the coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an 
end-of-life tire treatment facility operator to enter an attractive 
market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant 
authorities 
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 9M USD*

Plant capacity: 14,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 9.73 years

GDP Impact: 66M USD



Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has


Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue 
of USD 12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a 
CAGR of 6.9% during the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of 
reusable surgical products and rising awareness programs for 
medical waste management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided 
from public and private healthcare providers and 
transported to the facilities through waste collection 
and transfer operators in Al Qunfudhah Cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare 
sector are increasing the demand for healthcare 
waste management services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and 
further expansion of Al Qunfudhah are additional 
demand drivers and are projected to increase in 
the future

raw_data_json.description:
The project aims to establish a treatment and disposal center for hazardous industrial waste across Qassim Cluster.

The global industrial waste management market was valued at 
USD 791.14B in 2020. It is estimated to expand at a CAGR of 
10.4% from 2021 to 2031 

The global industrial waste management market is expected 
to cross the value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of 
the overall waste generated across the globe

The operation would mainly require a continuous input of 
hazardous industrial waste from private waste collectors. 
This opportunity also receives waste from other streams 
such as agricultural, healthcare and ELV waste.
The historic and projected growth in industrial 
sector as part of the KSA transformation requires 
innovative solutions for treatment of hazardous 
industrial waste
The drive to increase private sector participation 
and competitiveness in the economy are further 
drivers for formulation of the opportunity
The need to modernize waste management sector 
in the Kingdom is a key driver to attracting 
investors and operators 
* CAGR
M USD 

As KSA continues to expand the industrial sector as part of 
Vision 2030 the project enables a hazardous industrial waste 
operator to capitalize on a growing segment on Saudi Arabia's 
economy

The opportunity allows a potential investor to deliver a 
greenfield project with no constraints from legacy 
infrastructure in a developing sector enabling a full use of 
best-in-class operational and technical solutions

Expected Investment size: 530M USD*

Plant capacity: 746,941 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.3%

Payback period: 7.09 years

GDP Impact: 3,082M USD

Location (Region): Qassim Cluster

raw_data_json.description:
The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste vehicles treatment facility for the entire Qassim Cluster.

Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic 
drop, reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to 
decline in 2022, with a 2023 still below 2019

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life 
vehicles from producers for processing and transfer along the 
further waste treatment value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption 
etc.) are increasing vehicle consumption 
requiring uplift in waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven 
by the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase 
private sector participation require innovative, 
and sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA 
is expected to generate significant increase in consumption 
over the coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an 
end-of-life vehicle treatment facility operator to enter an 
attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant 
authorities 
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 11M USD*

Plant capacity: 52,500 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 13.97%

Payback period: 7.02 years

GDP Impact: 172M USD


full_description.raw:
The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste tire treatment facility for the entire Qassim Cluster.

Nearly one billion ELTs are generated worldwide annually, 
constituting more than 2% of the total amount of solid waste, and 
this waste flow is growing dynamically

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life tires 
from producers for processing

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption etc.) 
are increasing tire consumption requiring uplift in 
waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven 
by the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase 
private sector participation require innovative, and 
sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life tire 
treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant authorities 
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 34M USD*

Plant capacity: 15,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.3%

Payback period: 7.23 years

GDP Impact: 140M USD

Location (Region): Qassim Cluster

raw_data_json.description:
The opportunity aims to operate a healthcare waste treatment infrastructure across all Najran cluster.

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has 
increased to 2.6 M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue 
of USD 12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a 
CAGR of 6.9% during the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of 
reusable surgical products and rising awareness programs for 
medical waste management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided 
from public and private healthcare providers and 
transported to the facilities through waste collection 
and transfer operators in Najran Cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare 
sector are increasing the demand for healthcare 
waste management services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and 
further expansion of Najran are additional 
demand drivers and are projected to increase in 
the future

Drive to increase public sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further 
drivers for formulation of the opportunity
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 1M USD*

Plant capacity: 1,200 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 6.82 years

GDP Impact: 20M USD

Location (Region): Najran Cluster

Najran’s population is expected to continue to grow over the 
next few decades, which can potentially generate significant 
demand for the project

The investment opportunity focusses on creating waste 
treatment infrastructure, which provides a level of assurance 
while also offering attractive returns to potential investors


Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic 
drop, reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to 
decline in 2022, with a 2023 still below 2019

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life 
vehicles from producers for processing and transfer along the 
further waste treatment value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption 
etc.) are increasing vehicle consumption 
requiring uplift in waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation 
driven by the Vision 2030 and initiatives to 
increase private sector participation require 
innovative, and sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA 
is expected to generate significant increase in consumption 
over the coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an 
end-of-life vehicle treatment facility operator to enter an 
attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant 
authorities

consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing

driven by the Vision 2030 and initiatives to

authorities

market

authorities

raw_data_json.description:
The project aims to establish a treatment center mainly for hazardous industrial waste across Northern Borders cluster.

The global industrial waste management market was valued at 
USD 791.14B in 2020. It is estimated to expand at a CAGR of 
10.4% from 2021 to 2031 

The global industrial waste management market is expected 
to cross the value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of 
the overall waste generated across the globe

The operation would mainly require a continuous input of 
hazardous industrial waste from private waste collectors. 
This opportunity also receives waste from other streams 
such as agricultural, healthcare and ELV waste.
The historic and projected growth in industrial sector 
as part of the KSA transformation requires innovative 
solutions for treatment of hazardous industrial waste
The drive to increase private sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers for 
formulation of the opportunity
The need to modernize waste management sector in 
the Kingdom is a key driver to attracting investors and 
operators 
* CAGR
M USD 

As KSA continues to expand the industrial sector as part of 
Vision 2030 the project enables a hazardous industrial waste 
operator to capitalize on a growing segment on Saudi Arabia's 
economy

The opportunity allows a potential investor to deliver a 
greenfield project with no constraints from legacy 
infrastructure in a developing sector enabling a full use of 
best-in-class operational and technical solutions

Expected Investment size: 55M USD*

Plant capacity: 79,904 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 7.75 years

GDP Impact: 353M USD

Location (Region): Northern Borders Cluster

raw_data_json.description:
The opportunity aims to operate a healthcare waste treatment infrastructure across all Northern Borders cluster.

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has 
increased to 2.6 M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue 
of USD 12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a 
CAGR of 6.9% during the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of 
reusable surgical products and rising awareness programs for 
medical waste management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided 
from public and private healthcare providers and 
transported to the facilities through waste collection 
and transfer operators in Northern Borders Cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare 
sector are increasing the demand for healthcare 
waste management services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and 
further expansion of Northern Borders are 
additional demand drivers and are projected to 
increase in the future

Drive to increase public sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers 
for formulation of the opportunity
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 1M USD*

Plant capacity: 1,700 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 6.83 years

GDP Impact: 24M USD

Location (Region): Northern Borders Cluster

Northern Borders’s population is expected to continue to grow 
over the next few decades, which can potentially generate 
significant demand for the project

The investment opportunity focusses on creating waste 
treatment infrastructure, which provides a level of assurance 
while also offering attractive returns to potential investors

authorities

raw_data_json.description:
The project aims to establish a treatment and disposal center for hazardous industrial waste, located in Madinah 
Governorate

The global industrial waste management market was valued 
at USD 791.14B in 2020. It is estimated to expand at a 
CAGR of 10.4% from 2021 to 2031 

The global industrial waste management market is expected 
to cross the value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share 
of the overall waste generated across the globe

The operation would require a continuous input of 
hazardous industrial waste from private waste collectors
The historic and projected growth in industrial 
sector as part of the KSA transformation requires 
innovative solutions for treatment of hazardous 
industrial waste
The drive to increase private sector participation 
and competitiveness in the economy are further 
drivers for formulation of the opportunity
The need to modernize waste management 
sector in the Kingdom is a key driver to attracting 
investors and operators 
* CAGR
M USD 

As KSA continues to expand the industrial sector as part of 
Vision 2030 the project enables a hazardous industrial waste 
operator to capitalize on a growing segment on Saudi 
Arabia's economy

The opportunity allows a potential investor to deliver a 
greenfield project with no constraints from legacy 
infrastructure in a developing sector enabling a full use of 
best-in-class operational and technical solutions

Expected Investment size: 111M USD*

Plant capacity: 90,767 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.3%

Payback period: 7.68 years

GDP Impact: 560M USD

Location (Region): Madinah Cluster

source_opportunities.normalized_source_title: madinah end of life vehicles treatment facility

raw_data_json.description:
The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste vehicles treatment facility for the entire Madinah Cluster.

Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic 
drop, reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to decline 
in 2022, with a 2023 still below 2019

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life vehicles 
from producers for processing and transfer along the further 
waste treatment value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption etc.) 
are increasing vehicle consumption requiring uplift in 
waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven by 
the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase private 
sector participation require innovative, and 
sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life 
vehicle treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant authorities 
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 10MUSD*

Plant capacity: 45,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.3%

Payback period: 8.25 years

GDP Impact: 315M USD

Location (Region): Madinah Cluster

raw_data_json.description:
The opportunity aims to operate a healthcare waste treatment infrastructure across all Makkah Cluster.

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has increased 
to 2.6 M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue of 
USD 12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a CAGR of 
6.9% during the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of reusable 
surgical products and rising awareness programs for medical 
waste management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided 
from public and private healthcare providers and 
transported to the facilities through waste collection and 
transfer operators in Makkah cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare 
sector are increasing the demand for healthcare 
waste management services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and 
further expansion of Makkah are additional 
demand drivers and are projected to increase in 
the future

Drive to increase public sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further 
drivers for formulation of the opportunity
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 19M USD*

Plant capacity: 55,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 6.77 years

GDP Impact: 100M USD

Location (Region): Makkah Cluster

Makkah’s population is expected to continue to grow over the 
next few decades, which can potentially generate significant 
demand for the project

The investment opportunity focusses on creating waste treatment 
infrastructure, which provides a level of assurance while also 
offering attractive returns to potential investors

raw_data_json.description:
The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste vehicles treatment facility for the entire Makkah Cluster.

Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic 
drop, reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to decline 
in 2022, with a 2023 still below 2019

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life vehicles 
from producers for processing and transfer along the further 
waste treatment value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption etc.) 
are increasing vehicle consumption requiring uplift in 
waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven by 
the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase private 
sector participation require innovative, and 
sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life 
vehicle treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant authorities 
* CAGR




Expected IRR: 10.30%






full_description.raw:
The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste vehicles treatment facility for the entire Makkah Cluster.

Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic 
drop, reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to decline 
in 2022, with a 2023 still below 2019

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life vehicles 
from producers for processing and transfer along the further 
waste treatment value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption etc.) 
are increasing vehicle consumption requiring uplift in 
waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven by 
the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase private 
sector participation require innovative, and 
sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life 
vehicle treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant authorities 
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 36MUSD*

Plant capacity: 115,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 9.27 years

GDP Impact: 487M USD

Location (Region): Makkah Cluster

raw_data_json.description:
The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste tire treatment facility for the entire Makkah Cluster.

Nearly one billion ELTs are generated worldwide annually, 
constituting more than 2% of the total amount of solid waste, and 
this waste flow is growing dynamically

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life tires 
from producers for processing and transfer along the further 
waste treatment value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption etc.) 
are increasing tire consumption requiring uplift in 
waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven 
by the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase 
private sector participation require innovative, and 
sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life tire 
treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant authorities 
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 13M USD*

Plant capacity: 40,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 8.13 years

GDP Impact: 142M USD

Location (Region): Makkah Cluster

cross the value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of the 
overall waste generated across the globe

industrial waste from private waste collectors. This opportunity also 
receives waste from other streams such as agricultural, healthcare 
and ELV waste.

part of the KSA transformation requires innovative 
solutions for treatment of hazardous industrial waste
The drive to increase private sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers for 
formulation of the opportunity

Kingdom is a key driver to attracting investors and 
operators

on a growing segment on Saudi Arabia's economy

The project aims to establish a treatment center mainly for hazardous industrial waste across Hail Cluster.

The global industrial waste management market was valued at USD 
791.14B in 2020. It is estimated to expand at a CAGR of 10.4% from 
2021 to 2031 

The global industrial waste management market is expected to cross the 
value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of the overall 
waste generated across the globe

The operation would mainly require a continuous input of hazardous 
industrial waste from private waste collectors. This opportunity also 
receives waste from other streams such as agricultural, healthcare 
and ELV waste.
The historic and projected growth in industrial sector as 
part of the KSA transformation requires innovative solutions 
for treatment of hazardous industrial waste
The drive to increase private sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers for 
formulation of the opportunity
The need to modernize waste management sector in the 
Kingdom is a key driver to attracting investors and 
operators 
* CAGR
M USD 

As KSA continues to expand the industrial sector as part of Vision 2030 
the project enables a hazardous industrial waste operator to capitalize 
on a growing segment on Saudi Arabia's economy

The opportunity allows a potential investor to deliver a greenfield project 
with no constraints from legacy infrastructure in a developing sector 
enabling a full use of best-in-class operational and technical solutions

Expected Investment size: 18M USD*

Plant capacity: 16,423 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 7.63 years

GDP Impact: 105M USD


Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic drop,


The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life vehicles from 
producers for processing and transfer along the further waste treatment 
value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming consumer 
behavior in the Kingdom (increasing digitization, 
increasing personal consumption etc.) are increasing 
vehicle consumption requiring uplift in waste treatment 
solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven by the 
Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase private sector 
participation require innovative, and sustainable 
solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life vehicle 
treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste management 
sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project can expect high level of 
engagement from the relevant authorities

The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste vehicles treatment facility for the entire Jazan cluster.

Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic drop, 
reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to decline in 2022, with 
a 2023 still below 2019

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life vehicles from 
producers for processing and transfer along the further waste treatment 
value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming consumer 
behavior in the Kingdom (increasing digitization, 
increasing personal consumption etc.) are increasing 
vehicle consumption requiring uplift in waste treatment 
solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven by the 
Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase private sector 
participation require innovative, and sustainable 
solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life vehicle 
treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste management 
sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project can expect high level of 
engagement from the relevant authorities






Nearly one billion ELTs are generated worldwide annually, constituting 
more than 2% of the total amount of solid waste, and this waste flow is 
growing dynamically

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life tires from 
producers for processing the waste

The rise in personal wealth and transforming consumer 
behavior in the Kingdom (increasing digitization, 
increasing personal consumption etc.) are increasing 
tire consumption requiring uplift in waste treatment 
solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven by 
the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase private 
sector participation require innovative, and sustainable 
solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life tire 
treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste management 
sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project can expect high level of 
engagement from the relevant authorities 
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 2M USD*

Plant capacity: 5,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 8.04 years




raw_data_json.description:
The project aims to create a non-hazardous landfill mainly for municipal solid waste, throughout Jazan (Islands). 

Nowadays, modern landfill facilities are engineered with containment 
systems and monitoring programs.

In recent years, there has been a growing trend towards reducing the 
amount of waste sent to landfill and increasing the use of alternative 
waste management methods.

The main input to the operation comes from the Environmental 
Waste Treatment Centers (integrated facilities) for final 
disposal, which belongs to the municipal solid waste value 
chain.

Growth in Jazan’s population, personal incomes as well 
as continued transformation and increase in living 
standards are increasing the demand for waste 
management services

Waste management sector transformation driven by the 
Vision 2030 will require innovative, sustainable and 
scalable solutions to be deployed in Jazan Cluster
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 2M USD*

Plant capacity: 176,810 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 8.00%

Payback period: 10.74 years

GDP Impact: 24M USD

Location (Region): Jazan Cluster (Islands)

raw_data_json.description:
The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste tire treatment facility for the entire Dammam Cluster.

Nearly one billion ELTs are generated worldwide annually, constituting 
more than 2% of the total amount of solid waste, and this waste flow is 
growing dynamically

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life tires from 
producers for processing and transfer along the further waste treatment 
value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming consumer 
behavior in the Kingdom (increasing digitization, increasing 
personal consumption etc.) are increasing tire 
consumption requiring uplift in waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven by the 
Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase private sector 
participation require innovative, and sustainable solutions 
in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life tire 
treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste management 
sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project can expect high level of 
engagement from the relevant authorities 
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 59M USD*

Plant capacity: 30,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 7.68 years

GDP Impact: 242M USD

Location (Region): Dammam Cluster

raw_data_json.description:
The project aims to establish a treatment center mainly for hazardous industrial waste across AlBaha cluster.

The global industrial waste management market was valued at USD 
791.14B in 2020. It is estimated to expand at a CAGR of 10.4% from 
2021 to 2031 

The global industrial waste management market is expected to cross 
the value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of the 
overall waste generated across the globe


The project aims to establish a treatment center mainly for hazardous industrial waste across Asir cluster.

The global industrial waste management market was valued at USD 
791.14B in 2020. It is estimated to expand at a CAGR of 10.4% from 
2021 to 2031 

The global industrial waste management market is expected to cross the 
value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of the overall 
waste generated across the globe

The operation would mainly require a continuous input of hazardous 
industrial waste from private waste collectors. This opportunity also 
receives waste from other streams such as agricultural, healthcare 
and ELV waste.
The historic and projected growth in industrial sector as 
part of the KSA transformation requires innovative solutions 
for treatment of hazardous industrial waste
The drive to increase private sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers for 
formulation of the opportunity
The need to modernize waste management sector in the 
Kingdom is a key driver to attracting investors and 
operators

M USD

As KSA continues to expand the industrial sector as part of Vision 2030 
the project enables a hazardous industrial waste operator to capitalize 
on a growing segment on Saudi Arabia's economy

The opportunity allows a potential investor to deliver a greenfield project 
with no constraints from legacy infrastructure in a developing sector 
enabling a full use of best-in-class operational and technical solutions







Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic drop, 
reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to decline in 2022, with 
a 2023 still below 2019

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life vehicles from 
producers for processing and transfer along the further waste treatment 
value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming consumer 
behavior in the Kingdom (increasing digitization, increasing 
personal consumption etc.) are increasing vehicle 
consumption requiring uplift in waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven by the 
Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase private sector 
participation require innovative, and sustainable solutions 
in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life vehicle 
treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste management 
sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project can expect high level of 
engagement from the relevant authorities

full_description.raw:
The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste tire treatment facility for the entire Asir cluster.

Nearly one billion ELTs are generated worldwide annually, constituting 
more than 2% of the total amount of solid waste, and this waste flow is 
growing dynamically

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life tires 
from producers for processing the waste

The rise in personal wealth and transforming consumer 
behavior in the Kingdom (increasing digitization, 
increasing personal consumption etc.) are increasing tire 
consumption requiring uplift in waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven by the 
Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase private sector 
participation require innovative, and sustainable 
solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life tire 
treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste management 
sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project can expect high level of 
engagement from the relevant authorities 
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 8M USD*

Plant capacity: 12,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 9.85 years

GDP Impact: 53M USD

Location (Region): Asir Cluster

source_opportunities.normalized_source_title: al ahsa hazardous industrial waste treatment

raw_data_json.description:
The project aims to establish a treatment center mainly for hazardous industrial waste across Al Ahsa cluster.

The global industrial waste management market was valued at 
USD 791.14B in 2020. It is estimated to expand at a CAGR of 
10.4% from 2021 to 2031 

The global industrial waste management market is expected to 
cross the value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of the 
overall waste generated across the globe

The operation would mainly require a continuous input of hazardous 
industrial waste from private waste collectors. This opportunity also 
receives waste from other streams such as agricultural, healthcare 
and ELV waste.
The historic and projected growth in industrial sector as 
part of the KSA transformation requires innovative 
solutions for treatment of hazardous industrial waste
The drive to increase private sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers for 
formulation of the opportunity
The need to modernize waste management sector in 
the Kingdom is a key driver to attracting investors and 
operators 
* CAGR
M USD 

As KSA continues to expand the industrial sector as part of Vision 2030 
the project enables a hazardous industrial waste operator to capitalize 
on a growing segment on Saudi Arabia's economy

The opportunity allows a potential investor to deliver a greenfield project 
with no constraints from legacy infrastructure in a developing sector 
enabling a full use of best-in-class operational and technical solutions

Expected Investment size: 152M USD*

Plant capacity: 126,996 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 7.79 years

GDP Impact: 749M USD

Location (Region): Al Ahsa Cluster

source_opportunities.normalized_source_title: al ahsa healthcare waste treatment center

raw_data_json.description:
The opportunity aims to operate a healthcare waste treatment infrastructure across all Al Ahsa cluster.

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has increased to 2.6 
M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue of USD 
12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a CAGR of 6.9% during 
the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of reusable 
surgical products and rising awareness programs for medical waste 
management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided from 
public and private healthcare providers and transported to the 
facilities through waste collection and transfer operators in Al 
Ahsa Cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare sector are 
increasing the demand for healthcare waste management 
services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and further 
expansion of Al Ahsa are additional demand drivers and 
are projected to increase in the future

Drive to increase public sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers for 
formulation of the opportunity
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 1M USD*

Plant capacity: 3,500 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 6.83 years

GDP Impact: 40M USD

Location (Region): Al Ahsa Cluster

Al Ahsa’s population is expected to continue to grow over the next few 
decades, which can potentially generate significant demand for the 
project

The investment opportunity focusses on creating waste treatment 
infrastructure, which provides a level of assurance while also offering 
attractive returns to potential investors

full_description.raw:
The opportunity aims to operate a healthcare waste treatment infrastructure across all Al Ahsa cluster.

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has increased to 2.6 
M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue of USD 
12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a CAGR of 6.9% during 
the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of reusable 
surgical products and rising awareness programs for medical waste 
management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided from 
public and private healthcare providers and transported to the 
facilities through waste collection and transfer operators in Al 
Ahsa Cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare sector are 
increasing the demand for healthcare waste management 
services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and further 
expansion of Al Ahsa are additional demand drivers and 
are projected to increase in the future

Drive to increase public sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers for 
formulation of the opportunity
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 1M USD*

Plant capacity: 3,500 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 6.83 years

GDP Impact: 40M USD

Location (Region): Al Ahsa Cluster

Al Ahsa’s population is expected to continue to grow over the next few 
decades, which can potentially generate significant demand for the 
project

The investment opportunity focusses on creating waste treatment 
infrastructure, which provides a level of assurance while also offering 
attractive returns to potential investors

raw_data_json.description:
The aim of this opportunity is to create a waste vehicles treatment facility for the entire Al Ahsa cluster.

Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic 
drop, reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to decline 
in 2022, with a 2023 still below 2019

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life vehicles 
from producers for processing and transfer along the further 
waste treatment value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption 
etc.) are increasing vehicle consumption requiring 
uplift in waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven 
by the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase 
private sector participation require innovative, 
and sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA is 
expected to generate significant increase in consumption over the 
coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an end-of-life 
vehicle treatment facility operator to enter an attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant authorities 
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 33M USD*

Plant capacity: 52,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.3%

Payback period: 9.42 years

GDP Impact: 264M USD

Location (Region): Al Ahsa Cluster
