source_opportunities.normalized_source_title: al kharaj hazardous industrial waste treatment

raw_data_json.description:
The project aims to establish a treatment center mainly for hazardous industrial waste across Al Kharaj cluster.

The global industrial waste management market was valued at 
USD 791.14B in 2020. It is estimated to expand at a CAGR of 
10.4% from 2021 to 2031 

The global industrial waste management market is expected 
to cross the value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of 
the overall waste generated across the globe

The operation would mainly require a continuous input of 
hazardous industrial waste from private waste collectors. 
This opportunity also receives waste from other streams 
such as agricultural, healthcare and ELV waste.
The historic and projected growth in industrial sector as 
part of the KSA transformation requires innovative solutions 
for treatment of hazardous industrial waste
The drive to increase private sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers for 
formulation of the opportunity
The need to modernize waste management sector in the 
Kingdom is a key driver to attracting investors and 
operators 

As KSA continues to expand the industrial sector as part of 
Vision 2030 the project enables a hazardous industrial waste 
operator to capitalize on a growing segment on Saudi Arabia's 
economy

The opportunity allows a potential investor to deliver a 
greenfield project with no constraints from legacy 
infrastructure in a developing sector enabling a full use of 
best-in-class operational and technical solutions

Expected Investment size: 443M USD*

Plant capacity: 717,443 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 7.78 years

GDP Impact: 2,850M USD

Location (Region): Al Kharaj Cluster

full_description.raw:
The project aims to establish a treatment center mainly for hazardous industrial waste across Al Kharaj cluster.

The global industrial waste management market was valued at 
USD 791.14B in 2020. It is estimated to expand at a CAGR of 
10.4% from 2021 to 2031 

The global industrial waste management market is expected 
to cross the value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of 
the overall waste generated across the globe

The operation would mainly require a continuous input of 
hazardous industrial waste from private waste collectors. 
This opportunity also receives waste from other streams 
such as agricultural, healthcare and ELV waste.
The historic and projected growth in industrial sector as 
part of the KSA transformation requires innovative solutions 
for treatment of hazardous industrial waste
The drive to increase private sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further drivers for 
formulation of the opportunity
The need to modernize waste management sector in the 
Kingdom is a key driver to attracting investors and 
operators 

As KSA continues to expand the industrial sector as part of 
Vision 2030 the project enables a hazardous industrial waste 
operator to capitalize on a growing segment on Saudi Arabia's 
economy

The opportunity allows a potential investor to deliver a 
greenfield project with no constraints from legacy 
infrastructure in a developing sector enabling a full use of 
best-in-class operational and technical solutions

Expected Investment size: 443M USD*

Plant capacity: 717,443 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 7.78 years

GDP Impact: 2,850M USD

Location (Region): Al Kharaj Cluster


Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic 
drop, reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to 
decline in 2022, with a 2023 still below 2019

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life 
vehicles from producers for processing and transfer along the 
further waste treatment value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption 
etc.) are increasing vehicle consumption 
requiring uplift in waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation 
driven by the Vision 2030 and initiatives to 
increase private sector participation require 
innovative, and sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA 
is expected to generate significant increase in consumption 
over the coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an 
end-of-life vehicle treatment facility operator to enter an 
attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant 
authorities

raw_data_json.description:
The opportunity aims to operate a healthcare waste treatment infrastructure across all Al Jouf cluster.

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has 
increased to 2.6 M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue 
of USD 12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a 
CAGR of 6.9% during the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of 
reusable surgical products and rising awareness programs for 
medical waste management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided 
from public and private healthcare providers and 
transported to the facilities through waste collection 
and transfer operators in Al Jouf Cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare 
sector are increasing the demand for healthcare 
waste management services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and 
further expansion of Al Jouf are additional 
demand drivers and are projected to increase in 
the future

Drive to increase public sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further 
drivers for formulation of the opportunity
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 3M USD*

Plant capacity: 1,600 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 6.80 years

GDP Impact: 25M USD

Location (Region): Al Jouf Cluster

Al Jouf’s population is expected to continue to grow over the 
next few decades, which can potentially generate significant 
demand for the project

The investment opportunity focusses on creating waste 
treatment infrastructure, which provides a level of assurance 
while also offering attractive returns to potential investors

full_description.raw:
The opportunity aims to operate a healthcare waste treatment infrastructure across all Al Jouf cluster.

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has 
increased to 2.6 M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue 
of USD 12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a 
CAGR of 6.9% during the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of 
reusable surgical products and rising awareness programs for 
medical waste management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided 
from public and private healthcare providers and 
transported to the facilities through waste collection 
and transfer operators in Al Jouf Cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare 
sector are increasing the demand for healthcare 
waste management services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and 
further expansion of Al Jouf are additional 
demand drivers and are projected to increase in 
the future

Drive to increase public sector participation and 
competitiveness in the economy are further 
drivers for formulation of the opportunity
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 3M USD*

Plant capacity: 1,600 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 6.80 years

GDP Impact: 25M USD

Location (Region): Al Jouf Cluster

Al Jouf’s population is expected to continue to grow over the 
next few decades, which can potentially generate significant 
demand for the project

The investment opportunity focusses on creating waste 
treatment infrastructure, which provides a level of assurance 
while also offering attractive returns to potential investors

raw_data_json.description:
The aim of this opportunity is to collect and create a waste vehicles treatment facility for the entire Al Jouf cluster.

Global automobile sales began to recover from their pandemic 
drop, reaching 66.7 M units sold in 2021. It is expected to 
decline in 2022, with a 2023 still below 2019

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life 
vehicles from producers for processing and transfer along the 
further waste treatment value chain

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption 
etc.) are increasing vehicle consumption 
requiring uplift in waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation 
driven by the Vision 2030 and initiatives to 
increase private sector participation require 
innovative, and sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA 
is expected to generate significant increase in consumption 
over the coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an 
end-of-life vehicle treatment facility operator to enter an 
attractive market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant 
authorities 
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 5M USD*

Plant capacity: 12,500 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 9.50 years

GDP Impact: 60M USD

Location (Region): Al Jouf Cluster

full_description.raw:
The aim of this opportunity is to collect and create a waste tire treatment facility for the entire Al Jouf cluster.

Nearly one billion ELTs are generated worldwide annually, 
constituting more than 2% of the total amount of solid waste, 
and this waste flow is growing dynamically

The operation would require a stable input of end-of-life tires 
from producers for processing the waste

The rise in personal wealth and transforming 
consumer behavior in the Kingdom (increasing 
digitization, increasing personal consumption etc.) 
are increasing tire consumption requiring uplift in 
waste treatment solutions 

Waste management sector transformation driven 
by the Vision 2030 and initiatives to increase 
private sector participation require innovative, and 
sustainable solutions in KSA

The high level of economic and population growth in the KSA 
is expected to generate significant increase in consumption 
over the coming years, thus creating an opportunity for an 
end-of-life tire treatment facility operator to enter an attractive 
market

The Kingdom is placing a significant focus on the waste 
management sector as part of the Vision 2030 and the project 
can expect high level of engagement from the relevant 
authorities 
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 2M USD*

Plant capacity: 3,600 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.30%

Payback period: 8.17 years

GDP Impact: 24M USD


raw_data_json.description:
The project is aiming to establish construction and demolition waste (CDW) treatment and final disposal operator, offering services in Al Baha

The global construction and demolition waste 
management market size was $115 billion in 2020. 
The market is expected to reach $542.7 billion in 
2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% 
of the total waste produced worldwide and is 
expected to grow at a rate of 3.2 billion tons per year 
until 2025

The opportunity relies on a constant inflow of construction and 
demolition coming from private CDW collectors

Al Baha's population growth and expansion are the 
main drivers of construction and demolition waste 
generation

The increase in personal income and government 
incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the development 
of the infrastructure sector, which is expected to 
lead to an increase in waste generation 
necessitating further waste management solutions
* CAGR
M USD 

Due to continued growth in KSAs construction sector the 
project is looking to deliver greenfield opportunity in the sector 
with limited existing competition

The project is aligned with the KSA vision 2030 and has 
significant support within the Kingdom

Expected Investment size: 1.97M USD*

Plant capacity: 150,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.3% 

Payback period: 6.93 years

GDP Impact: 32M USD

Location (Region): Al Baha

Dawasir

The global construction and demolition waste 
management market size was $115 billion in 2020. 
The market is expected to reach $542.7 billion in 
2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% 
of the total waste produced worldwide and is 
expected to grow at a rate of 3.2 billion tons per year 
until 2025

The opportunity relies on a constant inflow of construction and 
demolition coming from private CDW collectors

Wadi Al Dawasir's population growth and 
expansion are the main drivers of construction and 
demolition waste generation

The increase in personal income and government 
incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the development 
of the infrastructure sector, which is expected to 
lead to an increase in waste generation 
necessitating further waste management solutions
* CAGR
M USD 


project is looking to deliver greenfield opportunity in the sector 
with limited existing competition

The project is aligned with the KSA vision 2030 and has 
significant support within the Kingdom

Expected Investment size: 4.62M USD*

Plant capacity: 150,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.3% 


full_description.raw:
The project is aiming to establish a fixed facility for construction and demolition waste (CDW) treatment, offering services in Northern Borders
 

The global construction and demolition waste 
management market size was $115 billion in 2020. 
The market is expected to reach $542.7 billion in 
2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% 
of the total waste produced worldwide and is 
expected to grow at a rate of 3.2 billion tons per year 
until 2025

The opportunity relies on a constant inflow of construction and 
demolition coming from private CDW collectors

Northern Borders's population growth and 
expansion are the main drivers of construction 
and demolition waste generation

The increase in personal income and 
government incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the 
development of the infrastructure sector, which 
is expected to lead to an increase in waste 
generation necessitating further waste 
management solutions
* CAGR
M USD 

Due to continued growth in KSAs construction sector the 
project is looking to deliver greenfield opportunity in the sector 
with limited existing competition

The project is aligned with the KSA vision 2030 and has 
significant support within the Kingdom

Expected Investment size: 4.53M USD*

Plant capacity: 300,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.3% 

Payback period: 6-8 years

GDP Impact: 95M USD



The global construction and demolition waste 
management market size was $115 billion in 2020. 
The market is expected to reach $542.7 billion in 
2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% 
of the total waste produced worldwide and is 
expected to grow at a rate of 3.2 billion tons per year 
until 2025

The opportunity relies on a constant inflow of construction and 
demolition coming from private CDW collectors

Yanbu's population growth and expansion are the 
main drivers of construction and demolition waste 
generation

The increase in personal income and government 
incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the 
development of the infrastructure sector, which is 
expected to lead to an increase in waste 
generation necessitating further waste 
management solutions

M USD

with limited existing competition


significant support within the Kingdom

Expected Investment size: 4.53M USD*

Plant capacity: 300,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.3% 



The global construction and demolition waste 
management market size was $115 billion in 2020. 
The market is expected to reach $542.7 billion in 
2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% 
of the total waste produced worldwide and is 
expected to grow at a rate of 3.2 billion tons per year 
until 2025

The opportunity relies on a constant inflow of construction and 
demolition coming from private CDW collectors

Hafar Al Batin’s population growth and 
expansion are the main drivers of construction 
and demolition waste generation

The increase in personal income and 
government incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the 
development of the infrastructure sector, which 
is expected to lead to an increase in waste 
generation necessitating further waste 
management solutions
* CAGR
M USD 

Due to continued growth in KSAs construction sector the 
project is looking to deliver greenfield opportunity in the sector 
with limited existing competition

The project is aligned with the KSA vision 2030 and has 
significant support within the Kingdom

Expected Investment size: 4.53M USD*

Plant capacity: 300,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.3% 

Payback period: 6-8 years



The global construction and demolition waste 
management market size was $115 billion in 2020. 
The market is expected to reach $542.7 billion in 
2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% 
of the total waste produced worldwide and is 
expected to grow at a rate of 3.2 billion tons per year 
until 2025


demolition coming from private CDW collectors

Al Qunfudhah's population growth and expansion 
are the main drivers of construction and demolition 
waste generation

The increase in personal income and government 
incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the development 
of the infrastructure sector, which is expected to 
lead to an increase in waste generation 
necessitating further waste management solutions
* CAGR
M USD 


with limited existing competition

The project is aligned with the KSA vision 2030 and has 
significant support within the Kingdom

Expected Investment size: 4.53M USD*

Plant capacity: 300,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.3% 


management market size was $115 billion in 2020.

of the total waste produced worldwide and is

management solutions

The project aims to establish an inert landfill facility for construction and demolition waste in Al Ahsa.

The global construction and demolition waste management 
market size was $115 billion in 2020. The market is expected 
to reach $542.7 billion in 2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% of the 
total waste produced worldwide and is expected to grow at a 
rate of 3.2 billion tons per year until 2025

The main input to the operation comes from the 
Construction and Demolition Treatment facility for 
final disposal.

Al Ahsa's population growth and expansion are the 
main drivers of construction and demolition waste 
generation

The increase in personal income and government 
incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the development 
of the infrastructure sector, which is expected to 
lead to an increase in waste generation 
necessitating further waste management solutions


Expected IRR: 10.3%



GDP Impact: 85M USD


necessitating further waste management solutions

expected in the Kingdom

market size was $115 billion in 2020. The market is expected

total waste produced worldwide and is expected to grow at a

Construction and Demolition Treatment facility for 
final disposal.

Medina's population growth and expansion are 
the main drivers of construction and demolition 
waste generation

The increase in personal income and


The Vision 2030 initiative includes the

is expected to lead to an increase in waste 
generation necessitating further waste 
management solutions

The project is aiming to establish a fixed facility for construction and demolition waste (CDW) treatment, offering services in Medina
 

The global construction and demolition waste 
management market size was $115 billion in 2020. 
The market is expected to reach $542.7 billion in 
2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% 
of the total waste produced worldwide and is 
expected to grow at a rate of 3.2 billion tons per year 
until 2025

The opportunity relies on a constant inflow of construction and 
demolition coming from private CDW collectors

Medina's population growth and expansion are the 
main drivers of construction and demolition waste 
generation

The increase in personal income and government 
incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the development 
of the infrastructure sector, which is expected to 
lead to an increase in waste generation 
necessitating further waste management solutions
* CAGR
M USD 

Due to continued growth in KSAs construction sector the 
project is looking to deliver greenfield opportunity in the sector 
with limited existing competition

The project is aligned with the KSA vision 2030 and has 
significant support within the Kingdom

Project is expected to have a stable supply of input material 
and a strong investment returns relative to peers in other 
geographies due to high number of construction projects 
expected in the Kingdom

Expected Investment size: 5.33M USD*

Plant capacity: 600,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.3% 

Payback period: 6-8 years

GDP Impact: 162M USD


final disposal.

Makkah's population growth and expansion are the 
main drivers of construction and demolition waste 
generation


incentives for homeownership

necessitating further waste management solutions

The project is aiming to establish a fixed facility for construction and demolition waste (CDW) treatment, offering services in Makkah
 

The global construction and demolition waste 
management market size was $115 billion in 2020. 
The market is expected to reach $542.7 billion in 
2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% 
of the total waste produced worldwide and is 
expected to grow at a rate of 3.2 billion tons per year 
until 2025

The opportunity relies on a constant inflow of construction and 
demolition coming from private CDW collectors

Makkah's population growth and expansion are the 
main drivers of construction and demolition waste 
generation

The increase in personal income and government 
incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the development 
of the infrastructure sector, which is expected to 
lead to an increase in waste generation 
necessitating further waste management solutions
* CAGR
M USD 

Due to continued growth in KSAs construction sector the 
project is looking to deliver greenfield opportunity in the sector 
with limited existing competition

The project is aligned with the KSA vision 2030 and has 
significant support within the Kingdom

Project is expected to have a stable supply of input material 
and a strong investment returns relative to peers in other 
geographies due to high number of construction projects 
expected in the Kingdom

Expected Investment size: 5.33M USD*



Expected IRR: 10.3% 


The project aims to establish an inert landfill facility for construction and demolition waste in Asir.

The global construction and demolition waste management 
market size was $115 billion in 2020. The market is expected 
to reach $542.7 billion in 2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% of the 
total waste produced worldwide and is expected to grow at a 
rate of 3.2 billion tons per year until 2025

The main input to the operation comes from the 
Construction and Demolition Treatment facility for 
final disposal.

Asir's population growth and expansion are the 
main drivers of construction and demolition 
waste generation

The increase in personal income and 
government incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the 
development of the infrastructure sector, which 
is expected to lead to an increase in waste 
generation necessitating further waste 
management solutions

M USD




Expected IRR: 10.3%

Payback period: 6.54 years

GDP Impact: 77M USD


final disposal.

Dammam's population growth and 
expansion are the main drivers of

generation

management solutions


The global construction and demolition waste management 
market size was $115 billion in 2020. The market is expected 
to reach $542.7 billion in 2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% of the 
total waste produced worldwide and is expected to grow at a 
rate of 3.2 billion tons per year until 2025

The opportunity relies on a constant inflow of construction and 
demolition coming from private CDW collectors
* CAGR
M USD 

Expected Investment size: 5.33M USD*

Plant capacity: 600,000 tons of waste per year

Expected IRR: 10.3% 

Payback period: 6-8 years

GDP Impact: 162M USD

Location (Region): Jeddah

•
Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) and sustainability consulting 
market is estimated at SAR ~ 2.0 Billion and is expected to grow ~ 2.6x 
by 2030
•
Limited local coverage across emerging sectors such as hydrogen, 
renewable energy, mining, and advanced manufacturing
•
Local service providers’ expertise consists of mostly generalist, with 
limited specialization in specific EIA topics like air dispersion, water 
quality, wastewater, etc.
•
Upcoming spend of SAR ~3,4602 Bn and SAR ~5502 Bn in 
construction & manufacturing projects, respectively
•
NCEC has introduced EIA requirements for category 2 & 
3 projects as a prerequisite for obtaining project permits; 
this is expected to increase demand for EIA
•
Targeted growth of ~40% YoY in NCEC registered entities 
is expected to drive demand for env. services
•
Tadawul published environmental reporting guidelines 
for listed companies and PIF is increasingly reporting on 
sustainability across its entities
•
Market is in its evolving stage, with demand expected to grow at 14% 
YoY across the period 2024 – 2030
•
Over 110 of EIA service providers are currently available, however, they 
remain insufficient to cover the market demand
•
Sustainability consulting market is dominated by local players; 
however, most of the market value is captured by experienced 
international companies offering specialized services
•
Global Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) market is growing 
rapidly, primarily driven by stricter regulatory compliance, and growing 
environmental awareness 
•
Integration of advanced digital technologies, such as AI and machine 
learning, in assessment processes
•
Utilization of remote sensing technologies, including satellite surveying, 
drones, and GIS
•
Incorporation of social dimensions by engaging indigenous and local 
communities in assessments

Environmental capability building market in KSA is estimated at SAR ~

•
Service provision is characterized by limited service coverage, given 
there is only two licensed entities in the Kingdom; this creates room for 
new entrants
•
Environmental services sector in KSA is at nascent stage; as such, end-
use sectors, environmental service providers, and governmental 
entities are likely to require environmental capability building services
•
Expected Investment size of SAR ~ 6 Million
•
Expected IRR: ~ 23% for the 10-year IRR
•
Payback period: 5.7 years
•
Location: Central region, Western region, and Eastern region
•
Capability building market is in its developing stage, with rapidly 
growing demand (13% YoY) presenting an opportunity for new entrants
•
Only two entities are licensed to provide capability building services 
with a very limited selection of topics, which presents a significant 
demand-supply gap
•
NCEC is targeting a 9x increase in registered entities with 
an environmental impact, requiring capability building to 
enhance their compliance
•
As service providers expand their service offerings to 
meet increasing demand, they seek specialized 
environmental training and upskilling from specialized 
providers
•
Listed entities are increasingly disclosing environmental 
performance, leading to growing demand for 
environmental capability-building services
•
Global market for environmental capability building services is 
experiencing significant growth, driven by increasing environmental 
awareness, stringent regulations, and the need for sustainable business 
practices
•
Market is serviced by a range of providers, including multinational 
consulting firms, specialized environmental consultancies, and industry-
specific experts
•
Strong focus on integrating digital solutions like e-learning and virtual 
training, and on building skills for technological adaptation, especially 
in environmental monitoring

The investment entails establishing a facility for the assembly of air quality monitoring equipment
•
Demand in KSA is estimated at SAR ~240 Mn, accounting for ~40% GCC 
demand and expected to grow 3x by 2030
•
Supply is ~ 100% imports dependent, with only two assemblers having 
limited utilization in KSA market 
•
In addition to the industrial market, presence of over 240 air 
monitoring stations drives demand through upgrades
•
Facility set up is supported by industrial zones providing access to 
facilities and utilities
•
Global air quality monitoring equipment market is growing at a CAGR 
of ~ 7%, driven by public and private sector initiatives to reduce air 
pollution 
•
Market is characterized by a mix of established multinational 
companies and specialized regional firms
•
Demand is rising for portable air quality monitors and comprehensive 
solutions that measure multiple pollutants simultaneously
•
Increasing integration of IoT sensors (e.g., CEMS) and ambient air 
quality systems into smart city infrastructure

KSA is a global leader in desalinated water production, with SWA

Investment pipeline in O&G and mining (SAR 7502 Bn) 
and manufacturing (SAR 5532 Bn) is expected to drive 
demand for soil testing
•
Soil testing market is nascent, with growth expected as 
NCEC standards introduced in 2021 become increasingly 
enforced
•
Market is at evolving stage, with demand expected to grow rapidly 
(19% YoY) in coming years, presenting an attractive opportunity for 
new entrants
•
Only ~30 service providers are licensed for environmental laboratory 
testing with over 80% being local entities

Absence of local laboratories that currently offer specialized 
environmental testing

Global market is growing at a CAGR of ~ 7%, driven by stringent 
government, rapid industrialization, and the development of advanced 
testing procedures
•
Market is characterized by a mix of multinational companies and 
specialized regional firms
•
Demand for mobile and on-site testing solutions is growing
•
Expanded testing scope is driven by emerging regulations and 
increased awareness of contaminants, such as PFAS and microplastics

source_opportunities.normalized_source_title: manufacturing of mechanical seals for industrial equipment

raw_data_json.description: This opportunity entails developing the value chain for the production of mechanical seals for industrial equipment to serve KSA and the broader GCC region.Overall demand for mechanical seals in Saudi Arabia has been growing, estimated to be 19,000 units in 2017. Driven by upcoming energy projects by Saudi Aramco, SEC and SWCC, demand is forecasted to increase at an annual growth rate of 6.1% to reach 30,300 units by 2025. Currently, KSA demand for mechanical seals for industrial equipment is addressed mainly domestically; however, the remaining 30% is addressed through imports, presenting a great opportunity for investors to localize production.Beyond the KSA market, investors in Saudi have the opportunity to tap into the larger regional market in the GCC. With a growing demand in the region for high-quality mechanical seals used in oil and gas, water and wastewater, and power projects, the demand in the rest of the GCC is expected to increase from 29,000 units in 2017 to 45,000 units by 2025.In addition to an increasing market demand, Saudi Arabia has competitive costs for materials, labor and logistics and offers funding and incentives to investors.The main focus of this opportunity is to establish a manufacturing facility for mechanical seals for industrial equipment.Manufacturing: establish mechanical seals manufacturing facility to fabricate seals components, the facility to include turning, boring, grooving, milling, drilling and tapping capabilitiesFinishing operations: establish workshops to deliver hard facing, grinding, lapping, polishing and welding capabilities in addition to advanced surface treatment proceduresHowever, additional opportunities for localization exist across the value chain of mechanical seals production. These opportunities include:Design: establish a design and engineering capabilitiesInput materials: establish local foundriesInstallation and maintenance: offer support services, including quality control, assembly, and installation servicesInstallation and maintenance: offer maintenance services and repair services for mechanical seals and installed base

raw_data_json.description: This opportunity entails developing the value chain for the production of circuit breakers to serve KSA and the broader GCC region.The overall demand for circuit breakers in Saudi Arabia has been growing, estimated at USD 370 million in 2018. Driven by utilities, oil and gas and other manufacturing industries, KSA demand is forecasted to increase at an annual growth rate of 4% to reach USD 439 million by 2022. In 2018, demand for circuit breakers is 60% for high voltage and 30% for low voltage and ~10% for medium voltage. The split is expected to remain relatively the same till 2022.Beyond the KSA market, investors in Saudi have the opportunity to tap into the large regional market in the GCC with expected increase in demand from USD 308 million in 2018 to USD 370 million by 2022.The focus of this opportunity is on final manufacturing and components manufacturing of circuit breakers. These opportunities entail:Components manufacturing: establish manufacturing facilities conductors, contacts, operating mechanism and enclosuresFinal manufacturing and testing: establish facilities for final manufacturing of low circuit breakersFinal manufacturing and testing: establish facilities for final manufacturing of medium voltage circuit breakersFinal manufacturing and testing: establish world scale testing facilities for (e.g., vacuum interrupter predictive testing)However, there are additional opportunities across the circuit breakers manufacturing value chain. Opportunities include:Design: custom design and engineer circuit breakers for low and medium voltage applications for Saudi customersInput materials: manufacture copper alloys to meet KSA's specifications

details.description:
Description of Investment Opportunity
Rua Al Madinah Holding, a PIF company, is a key driver in developing infrastructure and assets that enhance Madinah’s position as a premier destination with a contemporary architectural landscape.

As part of this mandate, Rua Al Madinah Holding is offering investment opportunities in three upscale hotel towers and four upscale commercial towers, located within the Dar Al Hijrah project, a landmark mixed-use urban development in the holy city of Madinah, Saudi Arabia.

 

Deal Structure

Flexible deal structures are available, with multiple partnership models such as joint ventures, real estate funds, investment consortia and land or building leases

Assets Under Consideration

Hotel Towers (Shell & Core)

Opportunity 1: ~380 keys, BUA +40,300 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 19 floors
Opportunity 2: ~380 keys, BUA +40,300 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 19 floors
Opportunity 3: ~614 keys, BUA ≈70,000 sqm, 2 basements + ground floor + 19 floors
Commercial (Office) Towers (Shell & Core)

Opportunity 4: BUA +72,250 sqm, land +10,650 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 11 floors
Opportunity 5: BUA +72,250 sqm, land +9,500 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 11 floors
Opportunity 6: BUA +72,250 sqm, land +13,380 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 11 floors
Opportunity 7: BUA +56,300 sqm, land +8,850 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 16 floors
Investor Participation

Investors may participate in one or more of these opportunities

keyGrowthDrivers.description: Vision 2030 alignment: Part of the national strategic development of Madinah, focusing on hospitality and tourism growth Accelerated time-to-market: Properties are partially completed, leading to short time-to-market and early recovery of investment cost High demand resilience: Madinah’s hospitality sector is known for consistent, year-round demand driven by religious tourism
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

Description of Investment Opportunity Description of Investment Opportunity
Rua Al Madinah Holding, a PIF company, is a key driver in developing infrastructure and assets that enhance Madinah’s position as a premier destination with a contemporary architectural landscape.

As part of this mandate, Rua Al Madinah Holding is offering investment opportunities in three upscale hotel towers and four upscale commercial towers, located within the Dar Al Hijrah project, a landmark mixed-use urban development in the holy city of Madinah, Saudi Arabia.

 

Deal Structure

Flexible deal structures are available, with multiple partnership models such as joint ventures, real estate funds, investment consortia and land or building leases

Assets Under Consideration

Hotel Towers (Shell & Core)

Opportunity 1: ~380 keys, BUA +40,300 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 19 floors
Opportunity 2: ~380 keys, BUA +40,300 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 19 floors
Opportunity 3: ~614 keys, BUA ≈70,000 sqm, 2 basements + ground floor + 19 floors
Commercial (Office) Towers (Shell & Core)

Opportunity 4: BUA +72,250 sqm, land +10,650 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 11 floors
Opportunity 5: BUA +72,250 sqm, land +9,500 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 11 floors
Opportunity 6: BUA +72,250 sqm, land +13,380 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 11 floors
Opportunity 7: BUA +56,300 sqm, land +8,850 sqm, 3 basements + ground floor + 16 floors
Investor Participation

Investors may participate in one or more of these opportunities Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg To be updated /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg 30 million visitors
Umrah visitors annually by 2030 Strategic Benefits Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers Vision 2030 alignment: Part of the national strategic development of Madinah, focusing on hospitality and tourism growth Accelerated time-to-market: Properties are partially completed, leading to short time-to-market and early recovery of investment cost High demand resilience: Madinah’s hospitality sector is known for consistent, year-round demand driven by religious tourism

• Reduce reliance on global suppliers for critical raw materials.
• Promote local R&D and industrial innovation.

The investment supports healthcare resilience and aligns with national priorities for local production.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Contribute to national drug security by reducing reliance on imports.
• Expand local industrial base and pharmaceutical ecosystem.
• Create high-value jobs and encourage knowledge transfer.

Targeted products include ophthalmoscopes, tonometers, ENT units, keratometers, otoscopes, tympanometry equipment, and more.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: • Rising cases of vision complications (e.g., glaucoma, cataracts, diabetic retinopathy) increasing demand for advanced eye diagnostic solutions. • Growing access to vision care services and awareness boosting demand for portable and reliable diagnostic tools.
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Healthcare Self-Sufficiency: Reducing reliance on imported medical equipment strengthens domestic supply chains and emergency preparedness.
• Growth Potential: Positions Saudi Arabia for strategic OEM partnerships in optical devices and enables expansion of local manufacturing capabilities.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

• Support modular diagnostic tools for obstetrics, cardiology, internal medicine, and emergency care.
• Enable development of a MedTech manufacturing ecosystem with regional export potential.

details.description: Establish local manufacturing of respiratory and oxygen therapy devices to support critical care and chronic disease management. This includes ventilators, CPAP, BiBAP, NO delivery systems, and devices for oxygen, ozone, and aerosol therapy. The opportunity targets hospitals, ICUs, emergency services, and home care environments.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: • High prevalence of respiratory conditions in the population. • Demand for modular and multi-purpose devices across different care settings. • Expansion of hospital infrastructure and critical care investments. • Potential for exports through regional medtech manufacturing leadership.
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Reduce reliance on imported medical equipment and build local manufacturing capacity.
• Strengthen national healthcare resilience, particularly for emergency and ICU settings.
• Support chronic respiratory disease management including asthma, COPD, and sleep apnea.

source_opportunities.normalized_source_title: adventure and water sport activity supplyer

details.description:
OPDC is seeking private sector investment and operational expertise to either JV or develop and manage a comprehensive range of water sports activities at THE RIG Project, a flagship tourism destination in Saudi Arabia. This opportunity allows private operators to provide services and equipment for various water sports while partnering with OPDC under a rent plus profit-sharing model. 

Products/services covered
- The opportunity targets a wide range of water sports and related services, including but not limited to:
- Adventure Water Sports: Kite surfing, surfing, jet skiing, e-foil rides, and motorized water sports.
- Recreational Water Sports: Diving, parasailing, snorkeling, and stand-up paddle boarding.
- Training Services: Professional lessons and certification for water sports enthusiasts.
- Rental Services: Equipment rentals for guests interested in independent water sport activities.
 
Focus of opportunity in the value chain

Upstream
- Investment in equipment and materials for water sports (e.g., jet skis, diving equipment, kite-boards).
- Recruitment and training of skilled personnel for operations and guest safety.
- Setting up operational hubs and storage facilities at “THE RIG”.

Midstream
- Service delivery, including providing water sports experiences, training, and rentals.
- Integration with “THE RIG’s” broader tourism offerings to enhance guest experiences.
- Adherence to OPDC’s standards for sustainability and safety.

Focus Area
- The opportunity is focused on offering a world-class, diverse water sports experience that complements the luxury tourism offerings at "THE RIG"

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia Adventure Tourism Market: Growing at 8-12% YoY. - GCC Water Sports Market: Growing at 6-8% YoY.  Mega Projects Boom – Government support tourism - High Demand for Experiences - Tourists are shifting towards unique, adrenaline-filled activities, creating demand for water sports such as kite surfing, e-foil, parasailing, and diving.
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• A unique opportunity to partner with a global tourism icon, a luxury, adventure-focused environment and become a vital part of the region's tourism evolution.
• OPDC is offering a lucrative rent plus profit-sharing model, enabling private sector players to generate consistent revenue without the need for significant upfront infrastructure investment.

full_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity OPDC is seeking private sector investment and operational expertise to either JV or develop and manage a comprehensive range of water sports activities at THE RIG Project, a flagship tourism destination in Saudi Arabia. This opportunity allows private operators to provide services and equipment for various water sports while partnering with OPDC under a rent plus profit-sharing model. 

Products/services covered
- The opportunity targets a wide range of water sports and related services, including but not limited to:
- Adventure Water Sports: Kite surfing, surfing, jet skiing, e-foil rides, and motorized water sports.
- Recreational Water Sports: Diving, parasailing, snorkeling, and stand-up paddle boarding.
- Training Services: Professional lessons and certification for water sports enthusiasts.
- Rental Services: Equipment rentals for guests interested in independent water sport activities.
 
Focus of opportunity in the value chain

Upstream
- Investment in equipment and materials for water sports (e.g., jet skis, diving equipment, kite-boards).
- Recruitment and training of skilled personnel for operations and guest safety.
- Setting up operational hubs and storage facilities at “THE RIG”.

Midstream
- Service delivery, including providing water sports experiences, training, and rentals.
- Integration with “THE RIG’s” broader tourism offerings to enhance guest experiences.
- Adherence to OPDC’s standards for sustainability and safety.

Focus Area
- The opportunity is focused on offering a world-class, diverse water sports experience that complements the luxury tourism offerings at "THE RIG" Key opportunity characteristics Strategic Benefits • A unique opportunity to partner with a global tourism icon, a luxury, adventure-focused environment and become a vital part of the region's tourism evolution.
• OPDC is offering a lucrative rent plus profit-sharing model, enabling private sector players to generate consistent revenue without the need for significant upfront infrastructure investment. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Saudi Arabia Adventure Tourism Market: Growing at 8-12% YoY. - GCC Water Sports Market: Growing at 6-8% YoY.  Mega Projects Boom – Government support tourism - High Demand for Experiences - Tourists are shifting towards unique, adrenaline-filled activities, creating demand for water sports such as kite surfing, e-foil, parasailing, and diving.

details.description:
The Rua Al Haram development project presents a strategic investment opportunity for private investors to participate in the design, construction, and operation of logistics and labor accommodation facilities critical to the success of this large-scale, multi-phase development. These facilities will play a pivotal role in supporting the project's construction and operational activities, addressing workforce housing, material handling, and overall construction logistics.

Based on the current forecast (subject to change) of daily labor personnel numbers, the labor accommodation would have the following key characteristics:

- Land  – The land required is based upon 3-story residential buildings = 300m.sq x 600m.sq = 180,000 m.sq land area.
- Capacity required – The employee residential facilities would be required for ~ 5,000 employees consisting of:
      - 1 Bedroom (40 sq. m per room) – 8
      - 1 Bedroom (20m.sq per room) – 112
      - 2 Bed per room (20m.sq per room) – 280
      - 4 beds per room (24m.sq per room) – 1080

- Additional facilities include kitchens, dining, recreation, sport, laundry, admin, security, medical, retail, fire station, swimming pools, parking, and utilities. Additionally, other facilities, such as - compounds for contractors, consultants' offices, warehouses, off-site manufacturing, etc. (typically requiring ∼1,500 m.sq. for 200 people.

This opportunity targets essential infrastructure and operational services, including worker housing, transportation, material storage, batching plants, construction logistics, and security systems. These offerings are critical to supporting the smooth execution of the Rua Al Haram project and ensuring its timely delivery. They also create long-term value for investors through sustained demand and operational scalability.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Rua Al Haram represents the region's unparalleled urban development initiative, setting a new benchmark for scale and ambition. Its portfolio comprises of hotel guest rooms, residential units, commercial space, and prayer areas. - The project is expected to require a workforce of significant scale, reaching over 100,000 workers at peak construction.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• This opportunity offers strategic alignment with national priorities, financially lucrative revenue streams, and the chance to play a central role in one of the region's most significant urban development projects. By addressing critical project needs for logistics and labor accommodations, investors can secure a high-impact, low-risk position in a transformative initiative with long-term growth potential.
• The strategic benefits of this opportunity are rooted in the scale and complexity of the Rua Al Haram project, regional development priorities under Vision 2030, and technological and operational advancements that enhance efficiency and scalability. These benefits ensure sustained demand, long-term profitability, and expansion opportunities.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• The opportunity provides diverse retail and residential offerings which align with the spending habits of luxury travelers and residents. The opportunity targets the affluent consumer market for luxury residential and retail offerings in a prime tourist destination.
• The Red Sea Zone Authority is working to create Smart Destinations with state-of-the-art infrastructure, which enhance the attractiveness and accessibility for both residents and visitors.

details.description:
KAFD has evolved to become a prime business and lifestyle destination capturing the core values of Vision 2030. KAFD empowers businesses through access to advanced office infrastructure and sustainable smart city solutions, while simultaneously offering unique lifestyle experiences with leading leisure and retail facilities. This opportunity focuses on residential assets for KAFD Area 7.

Deal Structure:
Joint venture future development  partnership

Assets Under Consideration:
Residential apartment products of a premium, luxury and branded nature. 
- Branded Residential Tower Parcels: 2 properties (354 units)
- Residential Tower Parcels: 4 properties (985 units)

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - The opportunity targets the executive level employees of KAFD’s Grade A Office market and HNWI who wish to invest or keep residence adjacent to the Financial Center. - Strategic Location - Strategically located at the center of Riyadh and accessible via three main access points, including Northern Ring Road, King Fahd Road and Thumama Road. KAFD is also a strategic component of the Public Transport system with its Metro Station a central connection point for the three main lines of Riyadh City.
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point: • KAFD offers a world-class mixed use development and is the Financial and Business Center of Riyadh. This component will offer luxury and premium residential to the working population of KAFD’s offices as well as a spectrum of investors who wish to own property in the heart of the city.

details.description:
Northern Community 3 is a premium mixed-use district featuring high-end residential, Grade-A commercial offices, and vibrant retail offerings.

It aims to foster a vibrant urban community that targets affluent professionals, executives, and families seeking a connected, modern urban lifestyle.

Deal Structure 
- Land sale
 
Assets Under Consideration
- Residential apartments – 1,800 units with 80,000 sqm. land take and 180,000 sqm gross floor area (GFA)
- Commercial offices – Grade A offices with 20,000 sqm. land take and 50,000 sqm (GFA)
- Retail – 3,000 sqm. land take and 6,000 sqm (GFA)

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Diriyah is a premier mixed-use development with 1.6 million+ sqm of commercial office GFA, 580,000+ sqm retail (GFA), approximately 18,000+ residential projects, 300+ branded residence units, 6,500+ hospitality keys, and 30+ hotels - Diriyah is anticipated to welcome 50 million visitors and be home to 100,000+ residents by 2030
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point: • Diriyah – The City of Earth – has traditional Najdi architecture and offers a diverse hospitality offering across lifestyle, and luxury, branded residences to meet the needs of a broad spectrum of visitors. Its strategic location is accessible within minutes of key commercial districts of Riyadh and is a 25-minute-drive from King Khalid International Airport

details.description:
Hail is emerging as a key destination for cultural tourism and adventure seekers, offering experiences rooted in its rich history, vibrant community, and scenic landscapes.

Deal Structure: Joint Venture Development Partnership.

The investment opportunity includes:
- An Urban Hotel: 145-key hotel capturing the region’s heritage while providing world-class services.
- Authentic Souq: A traditional market showcasing local products and crafts.
- Family Entertainment: Indoor and outdoor attractions for all ages.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Tourist Visit Growth: 54% CAGR in same-day trips (2015-2022), highlighting Hail’s rising popularity. - Increased Spending: 860% increase in tourist spending over the past five years. - Untapped Potential: Developing tourism infrastructure presents significant opportunities for early investors.  Investing in Hail offers high returns and aligns with Saudi Arabia’s growing tourism sector and Vision 2030.

details.description:
Description of Investment Opportunity
NEOM aims to become the world’s first 100% renewable electricity system with energy generation based mainly on solar. Energy storage is required to store excess solar energy during the day and release it at night. Pumped Hydro Storage (PHS) is the most mature and cost competitive storage available. Waterways and powerhouse to be located completely underground to improve land conservation, durability and aesthetics.

 

Deal Structure:
The project is envisioned to be structured as a Build–Own–Operate–Transfer (“BOOT”) in accordance with best industry practices
Time schedule assumes commercial and financial close in Q3 2025 and first energy in Q4 2029

Technical Considerations: 
- Installed capacity  – 2.2 GW
- Generation max power – 2.1 GW
- Storage capacity – 23.1 GWh
- Time constant in turbine mode – 11 hours
- Round trip efficiency – 80%

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - NEOM aims to create the world’s first 100% renewable energy system, underpinning demand for long-term energy storage. PHS will be the first of several PHS facilities at NEOM
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• PHS shall become an iconic piece of energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia
• Robust contractual structure in line with best international practices
• Stable and predictable cash-flows, credit support and risk allocation will ensure bankability of the project

details.description:
Jeddah Central Development Company is seeking a qualified private sector investor interested in partnering to finance the Oceanarium. The company is exploring different private sector participants.

A world-class oceanarium and coral farm, as well as a maritime research hub, situated along the coastal area of Jeddah. Designed by SOM from the United States the facility will feature seven pavilions (Shoreline and Mangrove, Coral Reef, The Vortex, Depth of the Red Sea, Back to the Shore, Restoration & Production of a Reef, and Technology & Products from the Red Sea) aimed at enhancing visitors' experience. The total land area is 43,924 m2, total Gross Floor Area (GFA) is nearly 21,076 m2, with an average capacity of 2,500 persons. 

The Oceanarium is situated at the Jeddah Center destination project, the heart of Jeddah, Saudi Arabia’s second-largest city, and gateway to Mekkah. Spanning an impressive 5.7 million m2, with 9.5 km of coastline. Jeddah Central is set to become a global waterfront destination with extensive mixed-use assets, including hospitality, retail, commercial, and residential properties, and key landmarks. The project is positioned as a leading tourist destination, aiming to preserve Jeddah’s rich culture while revitalizing the downtown area.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: Admission revenue, event space for corporates in coffee and gift shops, superb restaurants, VIP suites, rentals in glass-bottom kayaks, rentals in upcharge experiences (including tours, animal interactions, and sea trek helmet diving), and sponsorships are the seven largest revenue drivers, accounting for over 90% of total revenue.

• Investing in an income-generating asset under a PPP structure.
• Playing a part in financing an environment-friendly—including promoting biodiversity—a social asset with a positive social and environmental impact.
• Diversifying the investment portfolio.
• Fostering trust and collaboration with a leading PIF-owned portfolio company.

A world-class oceanarium and coral farm, as well as a maritime research hub, situated along the coastal area of Jeddah. Designed by SOM from the United States the facility will feature seven pavilions (Shoreline and Mangrove, Coral Reef, The Vortex, Depth of the Red Sea, Back to the Shore, Restoration & Production of a Reef, and Technology & Products from the Red Sea) aimed at enhancing visitors' experience. The total land area is 43,924 m2, total Gross Floor Area (GFA) is nearly 21,076 m2, with an average capacity of 2,500 persons. 

The Oceanarium is situated at the Jeddah Center destination project, the heart of Jeddah, Saudi Arabia’s second-largest city, and gateway to Mekkah. Spanning an impressive 5.7 million m2, with 9.5 km of coastline. Jeddah Central is set to become a global waterfront destination with extensive mixed-use assets, including hospitality, retail, commercial, and residential properties, and key landmarks. The project is positioned as a leading tourist destination, aiming to preserve Jeddah’s rich culture while revitalizing the downtown area.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: Admission revenue, event space for corporates in coffee and gift shops, superb restaurants, VIP suites, rentals in glass-bottom kayaks, rentals in upcharge experiences (including tours, animal interactions, and sea trek helmet diving), and sponsorships are the seven largest revenue drivers, accounting for over 90% of total revenue.
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Investing in an income-generating asset under a PPP structure.
• Playing a part in financing an environment-friendly—including promoting biodiversity—a social asset with a positive social and environmental impact.
• Diversifying the investment portfolio.
• Fostering trust and collaboration with a leading PIF-owned portfolio company.

details.description:
Saudi Jordanian Investment Company unveiled its pioneer project ‘The Kingdom Health’ in 2023, comprising of university with capacity of 600 students and hospital with 330 bed, 72 outpatient clinics and dedicated children’s hospital.

As a part of this project, an opportunity exists to develop and operate a greywater system.

Products covered and application
- Greywater systems in hospitals are used to recycle water from sinks, showers, and laundry for applications like irrigation, toilet flushing, and cooling systems, ensuring efficient water management

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Access to international affiliations with globally renowned institutions - High demand for modern healthcare facilities in Jordan due to rising population and focus on healthcare and medical tourism development
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Gain access and penetrate in the new regional markets
• Participate in healthcare project that is aligned with the national and regional goals

details.description:
Establish a facility to localize traction motor packing and winding.

Streamline the production and maintenance of traction motors, reduce lead times, and enhance control over quality assurance.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia to grow its rail network by 2.5x (to 13,000 km of track) and increase its freight volumes by 8x by 2030, which results in increasing number of traction motors, leading to increase in packing and winding - Regional demand growth due to upcoming projects (e.g. Etihad rail (UAE), Egypt Rail network)
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Saudi Arabia currently sends ca 400 traction motors annually outside the country for packing and winding
• No local capabilities in the region (mostly Europe-based)
• Demand for packing and winding is expected to grow across the region, resulting in significant service export potential

cardsData.stat:
SAR 350-400M (USD 93.3-106.7M)
[For a facility of 1,500 units per year, excluding land]

currentMarketCharacteristicsPoints.point:
• Consolidated supply landscape with five global OEMs – Caterpillar (US), Komatsu (Japan), Hyundai-Doosan (South Korea), Volvo (Sweden), and XCMG (China) – holding 75-80% market share
• Each OEM has exclusive local dealerships in Saudi Arabia for sales, distribution, and product support
• Saudi Arabia currently has no assembly facility; the local dealers import fully built-up units
• China, South Korea, India, Japan, and the US account for more than 90% of the imports (by value)

details.description:
Establishing one or more excavators and loaders assembly plants to address the local supply gap of 12,800-16,200 units per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Assembly of excavator and loader units with Stage V diesel engines
- Inclusion of adjacent capabilities in after-sales repair and maintenance services

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Export potential to the Middle Eastern and African market, given absence of assembly facilities in the region
• Advantage over other OEMs owing to customers’ preference for locally produced units for better demand responsiveness
• Opportunity to be an anchor investment in the heavy machinery production sector in one of the most promising and fastest-growing markets in the world

details.description:
- Establishing of one or more marble cutting factories to address the local supply gap of 7.9-10.2M sqm per annum
- Cutting of marble blocks to slabs for applications in the interiors of residential, hospitality, and commercial real estate developments

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Cumulative national demand of ~145M sqm of marble for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Opportunity to fill a gap in local supply chain as currently, no local players involved in cutting marble blocks to slabs
• Opportunity to gain a competitive edge as locally cut slabs of premium marble blocks imported from countries such as Italy and Spain will be more price competitive than slabs imported from the same countries
• Large facility with significant volumes will help achieve attractive EBITDA margins of 18-25% and rapid payback
• Current Market
• Characteristics
• Consolidated market with five local suppliers serving ~85% of the market; only slab cutting, and installation step is localized in Saudi Arabia
• All marble demand is met through imports because Saudi Arabia has limited marble reserves
• Oman, Italy, Egypt, and China account for more than two-thirds of the imports to Saudi Arabia
• All local players currently import marble in the form of slabs

- Products / Services Targeted: Assembly of cranes / hoists and manufacturing of components Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg ~SAR 177B (~USD 47.2B)
[Projected for 2025-40 across Saudi Arabia] Strategic Benefits • Locally manufactured units could be cost-competitive vs. imports (up to 15-25% less expensive to produce vs. Europe1) and more tailored to Saudi context (e.g., more resistant to Saudi Arabia weather); partnering required for safety, certification and brand recognition considerations
• Know-how required to manufacture crane elements (i.e., structure, drum and rope guide) available in Saudi Arabia
• Current Market
• Tower/Overhead cranes and hoists are currently 100% imported as SKD and then assembled with locally produced frames Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Cumulative national demand ~0.3M cranes and ~1.2M hoists for the 2025-2040 period

details.description:
Establishing one or more ceramic sanitary ware manufacturing plants to address the local supply gap of 13-17M units per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Production of mid-range and premium sanitary ware products across a wide product range (water closets, wash basins, bathtubs) 
- Full automation of production lines to ensure high-quality finishing

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Cumulative demand of ~380M units of ceramic sanitary ware in Saudi Arabia for the 2025-2040 period; mid-range and premium segments’ market share to grow, at the expense of the basic segment - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Opportunity to replace imported premium, super-premium, and mid-range sanitary ware products
• Local availability of key raw materials (kaolin, ball clay, feldspar, and silica, as well as gypsum and resin used for making the molds)
• Cost competitiveness of local production due to lower logistics cost and avoidance of 12% import tariffs
• Current Market
• Mid-range and premium segments together make up ~60% of the market
• Local players Saudi Ceramics, Al Forsan, Porsalina, Casa Via cater to basic and a small part of mid-range segment
• Global brands such as Kohler (USA), Roca (Spain), Geberit (Switzerland), RAK Ceramics (UAE) serve mid-range and entire premium segment
• Local suppliers of input materials
• Imerys (kaolin, ball clay), Gulf Sands (silica), Saudi Ceramics (feldspar)

details.description:
Establishing one or more facilities to manufacture spare components of excavators and loaders (buckets, accessories, cylinders, radiators, hydraulic hoses, track pads, and adjusters) to address the local supply gap of 300,000-390,000 tons per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Focus on catering to the spare parts market for post-warranty units (average post-warranty fleet size is ~48,000 units from 2023 to 2030)
- Future expansion potential to spares of other steel-based components (e.g., book, arm)

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Cumulative demand of ~SAR 38B for spares of buckets, accessories, cylinders, radiators, hydraulic hoses, track pads, and adjusters in Saudi Arabia for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Growing demand for third-party spares as OEM manufactured spare parts are priced 20-30% higher and often have long lead time of one-to-three months
• Local availability of raw materials (steel)
• Cost advantage over imported spares, which attract a tariff of 10-15%
• Limited manufacturers of components for excavators and loaders in the GCC; proximity to the markets with better pricing and lead times than those of OEMs will enhance competitiveness
• Current Market
• New equipment come with a one-to-two-year warranty during which OEM dealers offer servicing with OEM spare parts
• Post warranty customers are open to using third-party spares, primarily due to cost competitiveness
• Currently, the OEM dealers supply spares to the majority of the market even post warranty due to limited availability of locally manufactured third-party spares

details.description:
OPDC's THE RIG. project offers an opportunity for the private sector to propose innovative and sustainable mass mobility solutions for transporting visitors from onshore terminals to THE RIG. destination. This project spans 30 years, with the possibility of the operating model being based on a long-term lease or an operational management model.

The focus is on offering safe, efficient, and environmentally friendly transportation solutions, including options such as electric, hybrid, and cutting-edge technologies like sea gliders or hovercraft.

Products/services covered
The primary services targeted by this opportunity are transportation and mobility solutions for visitors. The focus is on providing a mass transit system that ensures safe, efficient, and comfortable transportation between onshore terminals and offshore on THE RIG. destination. The products or services could include
 - Electric or hybrid-powered transport options.
- Innovative transportation technologies (e.g., sea gliders, hovercraft).
- Long-term operational leasing or management services.
- Maintenance and safety assurance services for transportation solutions.
 
Focus of opportunity in the value chain

Design and Development
- The development and design of transportation solutions (e.g., electric/hybrid vehicles, sea gliders, hovercraft).

Manufacturing
- The production of transportation solutions, including any customization needed for offshore travel.

Operations
- Managing the transportation of visitors on a daily basis, including crew operations, maintenance, and safety management.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Tourism Sector Growth: Projected YoY growth of 7-8% through 2030. - The GCC region is expected to see a YoY growth of 5-7% in tourism.  Government Initiatives and Investments  Technological Innovations in Mobility - Innovations like electric, hybrid, and autonomous transportation systems.
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Tourism Development
• The project enhances the tourism sector, contributing to KSA’s ambition to become a leading global tourist destination. THE RIG project will likely attract significant numbers of international visitors, making efficient mass mobility solutions essential.
• Technological Leadership
• The opportunity allows for the integration of cutting-edge mobility technologies such as sea gliders and hovercraft, reinforcing Saudi Arabia’s position as a leader in innovative and advanced transport systems.
• Long-Term Revenue Generation
• With a 30-year span and the potential for long-term leases or operation models, the project offers significant financial returns, making it an attractive investment for the private sector.

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity OPDC's THE RIG. project offers an opportunity for the private sector to propose innovative and sustainable mass mobility solutions for transporting visitors from onshore terminals to THE RIG. destination. This project spans 30 years, with the possibility of the operating model being based on a long-term lease or an operational management model.

The focus is on offering safe, efficient, and environmentally friendly transportation solutions, including options such as electric, hybrid, and cutting-edge technologies like sea gliders or hovercraft.

Products/services covered
The primary services targeted by this opportunity are transportation and mobility solutions for visitors. The focus is on providing a mass transit system that ensures safe, efficient, and comfortable transportation between onshore terminals and offshore on THE RIG. destination. The products or services could include
 - Electric or hybrid-powered transport options.
- Innovative transportation technologies (e.g., sea gliders, hovercraft).
- Long-term operational leasing or management services.
- Maintenance and safety assurance services for transportation solutions.
 
Focus of opportunity in the value chain

Design and Development
- The development and design of transportation solutions (e.g., electric/hybrid vehicles, sea gliders, hovercraft).

Manufacturing
- The production of transportation solutions, including any customization needed for offshore travel.

Operations
- Managing the transportation of visitors on a daily basis, including crew operations, maintenance, and safety management. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 1B (USD 0.3B) /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 1.1B (USD 0.3B) Strategic Benefits • Tourism Development
• The project enhances the tourism sector, contributing to KSA’s ambition to become a leading global tourist destination. THE RIG project will likely attract significant numbers of international visitors, making efficient mass mobility solutions essential.
• Technological Leadership
• The opportunity allows for the integration of cutting-edge mobility technologies such as sea gliders and hovercraft, reinforcing Saudi Arabia’s position as a leader in innovative and advanced transport systems.
• Long-Term Revenue Generation
• With a 30-year span and the potential for long-term leases or operation models, the project offers significant financial returns, making it an attractive investment for the private sector. Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - Tourism Sector Growth: Projected YoY growth of 7-8% through 2030. - The GCC region is expected to see a YoY growth of 5-7% in tourism.  Government Initiatives and Investments  Technological Innovations in Mobility - Innovations like electric, hybrid, and autonomous transportation systems.

details.description:
Oil Park Development Company (OPDC) is seeking private sector participation to develop or provide accommodation for 2,300 employees working in the tourism and hotel sector at THE RIG.

This opportunity invites private investors to either construct new accommodation facilities tailored to the project’s needs, or propose existing assets that can be repurposed or adapted for this purpose.

Products/services covered
- Long-term workforce accommodation solutions (housing, utilities, and amenities).
- Hospitality services, including catering and housekeeping for employees.

Secondary Services
- Facility management (maintenance, operations, and security) and transportation services to and from THE RIG. site.

Focus of opportunity in the value chain

Upstream
- Design and development of accommodation facilities (construction or retrofitting existing buildings).
- Securing private investment or joint venture partnerships with OPDC.

Midstream
- Construction or adaptation of assets to meet OPDC’s specifications for employee accommodation.
- Development of infrastructure to provide utilities, transportation, and connectivity.

Downstream
- Day-to-day operation and management of the accommodation facilities.
- Providing services such as catering, cleaning, maintenance, and security.

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to build on Ma’aden’s high level of imports and establish a manufacturing plant for aluminum fluoride in Saudi Arabia.

- Application: Fluoride is a highly reactive and corrosive chemical element that is used in the mining industry for various purposes. This is primarily used in the production of aluminum.

- Products / Services Targeted: Raw Materials and Chemicals (Fluoride).

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - In 2018, Saudi Arabia imported 9KT of aluminum fluoride, representing 100% of its local demand.
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Aluminum smelting capacity expected to increase in short-medium term, creating further demand.
• Demand for aluminum fluoride mainly dependent on production of aluminum metal and therefore driven by increase in downstream production of aluminum.
• Easy access to local customer base (Ma’aden has significant demand for aluminum fluoride and is currently fully dependent on imports).

details.description:
SIRC subsidiary AKAM seeks a joint venture partner to establish, operate, and manage a state-of-the-art Construction and Demolition Waste (CDW) recycling facility in Saudi Arabia. This joint venture (JV) aims to transform CDW into valuable products, driving environmental sustainability and contributing to economic diversification.

Targeted Products
The recycling facility will focus on producing:
- Recycled aggregates.
- Sand.
- Other marketable materials derived from CDW.
 
Value Chain Activities
The JV will cover:
- Facility design and engineering.
- Construction and commissioning.
- Processing and recycling operations.
- Quality assurance and compliance.
- Sales and distribution of recycled products.

keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Supporting Saudi Vision 2030 goals of environmental sustainability and economic diversification.
• Enhancing landfill diversion rates and improving the recycling landscape.
• Contributing to the circular economy by transforming CDW into valuable products
