details.description:
OPDC is seeking private sector investment to develop and supply electricity for THE RIG. project, a flagship tourism destination in Saudi Arabia. The opportunity involves designing, financing, building, operating, and transferring (BOT) a power generation and/or distribution system to meet the high-energy demands of the project. The BOT model ensures a long-term partnership with private investors for a contract period of 30 years or more.

Products/services covered

Primary Service
- Reliable electricity generation and distribution tailored to the needs of THE RIG.

Target Solutions
Renewable energy options, hybrid power systems, or conventional energy generation solutions. Secondary Services: Maintenance, operation, and management of the power infrastructure for the duration of the BOT contract.

 Focus of opportunity in the value chain

Upstream
- Investment and financing by private sector players.

Midstream
- Development, installation, and commissioning of power generation and distribution infrastructure.

Downstream
- Ongoing operation, maintenance, and delivery of electricity to meet THE RIG.'s energy requirements.

Focus Area
The opportunity is primarily concentrated on establishing a sustainable and efficient energy supply chain that ensures operational reliability for THE RIG. while leveraging private sector expertise and capital.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia's electricity demand has been growing at an annual rate of 3-5% YoY. - The GCC’s electricity market is expected to grow by 2-4% YoY.

details.description:
- Description An opportunity exists to develop local capabilities for recycling Aluminum scrap.

- Application: Aluminum  scrap is recyclable materials from post manufacturing processes or consumption. Applications include reuse in aluminum  production. The process involves simply re-melting the metal, which is far less expensive and energy intensive than producing new aluminum  from Bauxite Ore.

- Products / Services Targeted: Raw Materials and Chemicals - aluminum  7602 Scrap – Mixed, Ext, Coated (UBC), 1st Quality.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - The global aluminum scrap recycling market size is estimated to grow at a significant CAGR of 8.9% during the forecast period 2022-2027. - 52 % (625 KMT) of total scrap generated in GCC countries is exported without being processed. - Diverse supply market, as aluminum scrap can come from a multitude of sources.
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Globally, aluminum is one of the most profitable materials to recycle and has achieved higher recycling rates due to government’s focus on energy saving, reducing wastage.
• Quality: Concerns around the quality of aluminum scrap – Ma’aden requires aluminum 7602 Scrap – Mixed, Ext, Coated (UBC), 1st Quality.

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to establish local manufacturing facility with a capacity of 250 ktpa for petroleum coke.

- Application: Petroleum coke is a carbon-rich solid material that is produced during oil refining. In its raw form it is known as Green Petroleum Coke (GPC). It is used for carbon anode manufacturing in aluminum smelters

- Products / Services Targeted: Raw Materials and Chemicals (Petroleum Coke).

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - First mover advantages due to lack of established capacity in Saudi Arabia. - Ma’aden Aluminum would be the primary buyer within Saudi Arabia. - Saudi Arabia’s geographical advantage and trade agreements with neighboring countries make exporting favorable.
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Calcined Petroleum Coke (CPC) offers good potential with favorable logistics to export to rest of the leading MENA aluminum smelters and steel plants – very large amount of foreign spend to be localized.
• Saudi Arabia has proximity to raw material (Green Petroleum Coke) sources, including UAE and Oman – increasing investment opportunity.
• Ma’aden have agreed a major deal signed from 2025 onwards to purchase Pet Coke locally from new facility in Saudi Arabia. Despite this agreement, there is still significant opportunity to build on local capability within Saudi Arabia.

- Description: Significant opportunity exists to establish local capacity of 7500 (MTPA) minimum. 

Saudi Arabia can leverage its strategic location and strong logistics infrastructure to enhance export capability.

- Products / Services Targeted: Raw Materials and Chemicals (Alloys)

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Titanium alloys: Global Titanium Alloy Market Was Valued at US$4.3B in 2021 and is Projected to Reach US$8.4B by the End of 2029, Exhibiting a healthy CAGR of 6.5% Between 2022 and 2029. - Manganese-based alloys: Global growth at a rate of 4.7% in the forecast period 2022 to 2029.
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Saudi Arabia has the world’s largest integrated Aluminum city at Ras Al-Khair which provides easy & uninterrupted access of feedstock.
• Saudi Arabia is strategically located at the crossroads of several markets that have good demand potential.
• Saudi Arabia benefits from having abundant and easy access to utilities, raw materials and a world class infrastructure with good access to port.
• Progressive value chain integration will position Aluminum master alloys as an attractive niche product offering value addition potential locally, with high export opportunities and higher netback realization.

- Specifications:
1. Setting up a smart water meters manufacturing plant.
2. Setting up a smart water meter component manufacturing plant to cater to water sector requirements across the local and regional markets.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia water meter expected to grow by ~8% CAGR until 2030 primarily driven by shift towards smart water meter. - Increased rate of home ownership (70% targeted by 2030) would spur demand for water meter connections. - Additional 1.9 m connections of water and wastewater connections driving the need for smart water meters. - Replacement of conventional meters with smart water meter. - Projects such as NEOM, the Red Sea Project, Qiddiya Entertainment City, King Abdullah Financial District and Amaala to create significant demand. - Further growth can be expected if NWC decides to install water meter in every households ( Currently in many cases water meter are installed at a building level).
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point: • High potential of localization of meter manufacturing as local sourcing of key component and material is available in KSA.

details.description:
National Additive Manufacturing & Innovation Company (NAMI), a joint venture between 3D Systems Corporation and Dussur, specializes in first of its kind innovation and 3D printing center.

The opportunity lies in providing a range of post-processing services to enhance the quality, functionality, and performance of manufactured products in Saudi Arabia.

Products/Services covered

Surface finishing
- Sanding, polishing, sand blasting, shot peening, chemical milling, tumbling, electropolishing, abrasive flow machining, painting

Heat treatment
- Stress relief, aging, solution annealing (vacuum HT) for Steels, Ni-alloys, Titanium, Al-alloys

Cleaning
- Ultrasonic cleaning, chemical cleaning, advanced de-powdering

Inspection and quality control
- Dimensional inspection (CMM, optical), non-destructive testing (X-Ray, FPI, DPI), powder flowability & PSD

Assembly and integration
- Final assembly of components, coatings

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to invest in expanding the local supply of Magnesium by establishing plant with a capacity of 30 ktpa.

- Magnesium is mainly used in aluminum  alloys (34% of global demand), magnesium die-castings (32% of global demand) and titanium sponge production (15% of demand). Other end-uses include steel desulphurization, iron casting and cathodic protection.

- Application: Magnesium is a lightweight, silvery-white metal that is commonly used in the mining industry. Magnesium oxide (MgO) is produced by the calcination of magnesium carbonate.

- Products / Services Targeted: Raw Materials and Chemicals (Magnesium).

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia has abundant dolomite resources which could be used as feedstock for the magnesium metal plant.
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Increasing demand is driven by the growth of the automotive industry and their need for magnesium die casting.
• Saudi Arabia and global market is projected to continue to grow until the year 2030 and beyond (extreme CAGR of 10.8%).

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to develop local capabilities for sodium cyanide.

- Potential to collaborate with local industries and waste management facilities to utilize byproducts, creating a circular economy model that minimizes waste and maximizes resource utilization.

- Application: Sodium cyanide, a chemical compound renowned for its role in the mining sector, is indispensable for gold extraction processes. Its ability to form stable complexes with gold allows for efficient separation from ore, enabling extraction methods like cyanidation. 

- Products / Services Targeted: Raw Materials and Chemicals - Sodium Cyanide (Assay solid with 98% purity in cubic form).

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - MENA is the biggest importer of Sodium Cyanide. Asia is the biggest exporter. - Ma’aden procures only one type of Sodium Cyanide (Assay solid with 98% purity in cubic form). - Potential to collaborate with Ma’aden, providing essential sodium cyanide for gold extraction.
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Increases in mining activity would create increased demand for sodium cyanide.
• Resource synergy – Saudi Arabia has abundant petrochemical resources, helping to create a secure and local supply chain for key raw materials required for sodium cyanide production, creating cost-efficiencies and reliability
• Proportional increases in demand with expansion of the mining industry / sector.

• OEMs utilize similar circuit boards, chips, antennas, and semiconductors across their cross-industrial service portfolio, driving potential for national demand consolidation
• Having no local or regional players, there is a significant potential for exportation of components

details.description:
- Localizing the production of finished automotive lights to supply to the local OEMs in Saudi Arabia. Products include exterior light for vehicles e.g., headlights, taillights, braking strips and fog lights.
- Automotive-grade lights technology can be used to manufacture lights for other vehicles e.g., bus, trucks.
- This opportunity occurs in tier-1 manufacturing phases, prior to the assembly/distribution.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Localization of OEMs production in Saudi Arabia, with confirmed projects by Lucid, Ceer – expected production of 300,000+ vehicles a year. - 17% CAGR estimated for Saudi Arabia demand (mainly from automotive applications). - Increasing regulations regarding the use of effective lightings in automobiles for increased safety. - Increasing demand for premium segment vehicles, with advanced lighting technologies.
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Meet demand from OEM projects, with proximity to OEMs.
• Develop automotive-grade light manufacturing capabilities in Saudi Arabia.
• Leverage low raw material (plastic) prices in Saudi Arabia.
• Leverage capabilities for other vehicle types (e.g., bus).

source_opportunities.normalized_source_title: outside plant optical distribution network odn

details.description:
- Description: localize assembly of outside plant optical distribution networks (ODNs), which the portion located outside buildings or underground responsible for distributing optical signals from the point of presence to the customer premises. The ODN specifically has five segments: feeder fiber, optical distribution point, distribution fiber, optical access point, and drop fiber.

- Product: ODNs include key passive equipment, such as splitters or fiber distribution cabinets, and are the essential path for PON data transmission.

- Customers: potential key clients include telecoms operators and data center players (for data center networking).

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Increasing local demand in relevant sectors: telecoms operators' fixed network coverage expansion and data center construction. - Localization of spend in optical distribution networks by STC, PIF's Portfolio Company (approximately SAR 400M 5-years' cumulative demand).
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point: • Large potential for import substitution (Saudi Arabian demand mostly supplied by foreign producers).

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Refractory Saudi demand in 2020 was 160-170 ktpa, growing at 6-7% CAGR until 2027. - Significant growth expected in the global market as well as in Saudi Arabia in the years to come. - Similar growth observed in neighboring countries, thus opening the filtration market beyond Saudi Arabia.
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point: • Demand for the refractory materials will be mainly driven by recovery in the construction, infrastructure industrial, and mining sectors.

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• The global market size for bearings is estimated at USD 48B for 2021, increasing to USD 56B by 2026 (CAGR of 3.4% during period).
• In Saudi Arabia, local demand is supplied via imports, while global firms import and distribute in Saudi Arabia. This prompts a chance for local production to replace imports.
• Saudi Arabia demand for Bearings, Bushings, & Wheels is met through imports with 84% of this demand originating from high-cost countries

details.description:
- Manufacturing of Aluminum extrusion products for applications in vehicles especially catering to the demand from Saudi Arabia-based OEMs.
- Product mainly include aluminum extrusion structures for EVs  e.g., roof rails, door frames, dashboard frame and supports, profiles for battery frame.
- Manufacturing of aluminum extrusion components can be supplied to tier-1 suppliers or directly to OEMs. This opportunity occurs in tier-2 and tier-1 manufacturing phases, prior to the assembly/distribution.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Localization of OEMs production in Saudi Arabia, with confirmed projects by Lucid, Ceer – expected production of >300,000 vehicles a year. - Aluminum is considered a favored material for EVs, as it offers value to OEMs in terms of manufacturing costs, weight savings & performance. - Average aluminum content in a light vehicle is expected to increase to 222 kg/ vehicle by 2030. - 17% CAGR estimated for Saudi Arabia demand (mainly from automotive applications).
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Leverage availability of raw material in Saudi Arabia.
• Cater to localization requirements of OEM projects, while fostering high-precision aluminum extrusion capabilities in Saudi Arabia.
• Expand aluminum extrusion capability into other applications (e.g., construction industry).

details.description:
- Manufacturing of carpets and acoustic systems for light vehicle applications, to be used for car interior/ hood/ underbody/ trunk.
- Acoustic/ insulation systems for OEM/ Tier-1 requirements e.g., car headliner, trunk, door trim, e-motor, battery, wheel encapsulation, instrument panel, center console.
- This opportunity occurs in tier-1 and tier-2 manufacturing phases, prior to the assembly/distribution with potential production opportunity for aftersales market.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Localization of OEMs production in Saudi Arabia, with confirmed projects by Lucid, Ceer – expected production of >300,000 vehicles a year. - Rising demand for vehicle carpet customization (color, texture, and design). - Increasing use of high-quality, scratch-resistant material for floor carpets. - Increasing demand for enhanced comfort and safety features (e.g., material that allows noise levels to remain within permissible limits).
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Cater to localization requirements of OEM projects.
• Leverage low raw material (plastic, fibers) prices in Saudi Arabia.
• Potentially expand into other vehicle segments and consumer goods.

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to establish a new local pumps and compressors facility to supply multiple Saudi markets and industries.

- Application: Pumps are a vital mechanical tools utilized in the mining industry that propel liquids or gases through mechanical means. They play a crucial role in tasks such as fluid transport & enhancing operational efficiency.

- Products/Services Targeted: Equipment MRO (Pumps).

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - The global market is growing at 5% per annum (2021 to 2030), and Saudi Arabia market size demand is growing by 3-5% annually (2018 to 2024). - Local manufacturers supply to 50% of the local demand, with a utilization rate of 85%.
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Gain new market share in a continuously evolving and expanding market.
• Steady demand from multiple domestic industries that require annual repair & replacement of the pumps.

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to establish local manufacturing facility and develop capabilities for pipes, hoses and connections.

- Application: Pipes and connections are vital in mining, enabling the transport of minerals and maintaining breathable air through ventilation systems, ensuring efficient and safe operations in demanding conditions.

- Products / Services Targeted: Equipment MRO (Pipes, hoses and connections).

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Growing mining industry, pipes would directly support the SAR 4.8 Tn of untapped mining potential. - The Saudi demand for pipe fittings is expected to make up ~40% of the overall GCC demand. - First mover advantage given limited presence of local production facility.
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Saudi Arabia is currently developing sustainably semi-finished & finished metal industries (downstream).
• Currently, Saudi Arabia's demand for pipe fittings is addressed almost fully through imports (94% of total demand), presenting a great opportunity to localize production.

details.description:
Localize ToS associated services.

ToS associated services may include:
- Database administration services which involve the management, maintenance, and optimization of databases by a team of experts.
- ToS support services which include technical support for ToS systems and software updates.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia to increase port throughput from 9M TEU to 40M TEU by 2030, which results in increased need for ToS associated services to improve efficiency, resulting in higher spend on these services. - Future digitization efforts (i.e., smart ports) are expected to drive data traffic volume growth by ca 26% per annum. - Regional demand growth due to upcoming projects (e.g., Kuwait port expansion).
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Associated services are outsourced to global players today.
• Potential to expand these services to GCC port operators, since ToS systems deployed in the region are similar to the ones in Saudi Arabia (e.g., Abu Dhabi ports – Master Terminal ToS; Mwani – Navis N4 ToS).

-As a part of Vision 2030, ‘Wasfaty program’ has been launched as an advanced electronic service to raise the level of services and enhancing availability of medicines in Saudi Arabia.

-As a part of this program, an opportunity exists to set up and operate e-pharmacy operations utilizing Wasfaty’s e-prescription software to serve the Saudi healthcare market.

-Dispensing and e-pharmacies play a crucial role in accurate, safe and convenient medication delivery, in alignment with national targets for the healthcare sector.  

-Preference is for local pharmacy operators and investors with track-record on e-pharmacy operations.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Rapidly growing and technologically transforming healthcare sector in Saudi Arabia driven by ‘Health Sector Transformation Program’ as a part of Saudi Vision 2030. - The population of Saudi Arabia is rapidly growing with the population expected to reach 39.7 million by 2030.
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Gain new market share in the largest healthcare market (by healthcare expenditure) in the MEA market.
• Limited local supply in Saudi Arabia despite growing demand.

-As a part of this program, an opportunity exists to set up and operate e-pharmacy operations utilizing Wasfaty’s e-prescription software to serve the Saudi healthcare market.

-Dispensing and e-pharmacies play a crucial role in accurate, safe and convenient medication delivery, in alignment with national targets for the healthcare sector.  

-Preference is for local pharmacy operators and investors with track-record on e-pharmacy operations.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Rapidly growing and technologically transforming healthcare sector in Saudi Arabia driven by ‘Health Sector Transformation Program’ as a part of Saudi Vision 2030. - The population of Saudi Arabia is rapidly growing with the population expected to reach 39.7 million by 2030.
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Gain new market share in the largest healthcare market (by healthcare expenditure) in the MEA market.
• Limited local supply in Saudi Arabia despite growing demand.

details.description:
Deal Structure:
The Project presents an investment opportunity for the private sector to enter into a development agreement to design, build, finance, operate, insure, and maintain a Construction and Staff Village The transaction will be structured as a 32-year deal, with an upfront investment of ~SAR 2-3B required from the private sector for construction

Assets Under Consideration:
- The project will involve development of a ~12,300-bed Construction Village to meet the short-term demand for 2 years in 2024-2026
- The development will then be converted, over a 3-month rolling refurbishment period, to a permanent ~8,500-bed Staff Village to meet the long-term staff accommodation demand for 30 years
- The project will accommodate a portion of the staff expected to be employed

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Access to NEOM : Opportunity to become a key development and investment partner in developing NEOM, and access subsequent investment opportunities across NEOM - Promising tourism demand: Demand for hotel assets is expected to be very high, as NEOM is planned to be a key tourist attractor for the wider region with its unique offerings and year-round activities
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Captive and exclusive tenant market: hotels / hospitality businesses will use these staff villages on an exclusive basis, therefore de-risking the investment
• Consistent cash flow generation during the construction phase: the construction village will be used by captive contractors’ staff ensuring high utilization and cash flow generation
• NEOM commitment: significant developments are already underway
• Capital efficient investment: opportunity to invest into a unique product with low refurbishment costs to convert into Staff Village, and generating long term cashflows

Establish local manufacturing/ retreading facility specializing in industrial tires for trucks and mobile cranes (e.g., rubber-tired gantry cranes).

Manufacture tires for heavy equipment used in numerous sectors (e.g., maritime sector for container handlers, construction industry for loaders, mining sector for haul trucks), including:

- Retreading

• There are currently no local players in manufacturing tires for heavy equipment
• High expected demand for retreaded tires for heavy equipment, given financial upside to end-user (retreaded tires can endure 75 – 80% of the lifetime of new tires, provided they are well maintained)
• Export potential3 of SAR 400 – 500M annually

• Growing mining industry as the third pillar of the Saudi economy – with growth in mining comes growth in demand for associated laboratory services.

details.description:
Establish a local UTEX providing a comprehensive inventory of spare parts, increasing availability.

A UTEX allows a defective part in the rail sector to be replaced in a few days, while it gets repaired to new condition and goes into UTEX inventory.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia to grow its rail network by 2.5x (to 13,000 km of track), increase passenger volume by 10x, and increase freight volumes by 8x by 2030, which results in increasing use for spare parts, and therefore increasing maintenance, repairs and operations spend. - Regional demand growth due to upcoming projects (e.g., Etihad rail (UAE), Egypt Rail network).
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Saudi-based UTEX will be well-positioned to cater to the broader GCC rolling stock spares market.
• Export potential of SAR 100 – 150 M annually.
• Opportunity to replace imports of new spare parts to Saudi Arabia.

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to invest in capability within Saudi Arabia to counter the strong foreign supply to Saudi Arabia.

- Application: Pitch is used in electrode production in the aluminum  industry.

- Products / Services Targeted: Liquid pitch manufacturing facility.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Global liquid pitch market estimated at SAR 13.1B in 2020, expected to reach SAR 19.1B by 2027 registering a CAGR of 5.4%. - Demand for pitch is driven by end use industries such as aluminum and Steel, both of which are growing in Saudi Arabia.
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Resource availability – abundant access to petroleum resources, a primary source for producing liquid pitch. Leveraging local resources ensures a stable supply chain and has cost advantages.
• Potential to position liquid pitch manufacturing facility strategically to supply neighboring countries in the Gulf region. Saudi Arabia's geographical proximity and connectivity enhances export potential.

details.description:
- Establishment of a manufacturing facility to produce running gear spare parts, i.e., wheelsets and axles.
- Wheels should be built through forging process, with an average wheel life of 200,000 km in KSA climate conditions.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia to grow its rail network by ~2.5x (to 13,000 km of track), which will result in additional need for running gear spare parts, implying increasing spend on wheelsets . - Regional demand growth due to upcoming projects (e.g., Etihad rail (UAE), Egypt Rail network).
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Only 1% of SAR’s spare part stock value is KSA-made.
• Steel wheels account for 30-50% of annual running gear OPEX spend at SAR.
• Export potential of SAR 100 – 150 M annually.

details.description:
Establish a manufacturing facility for spare parts for cargo handling equipment, with the potential to expand into components for other heavy vehicles such as trucks and prime movers.
Manufacture components such as:
- Engine components (e.g., alternators) (replacement rate of 10,000 – 15,000 hours of operations).
- Invertors (replacement rate of 18,000 – 20,000 hours of operations).
- Electrical components (e.g., capacitor, circuit breakers) (replacement rate of 18,000 – 20,000 hours of operations).
- Mechanical components (e.g., steering columns, pumps, pulleys) (replacement rate of 8,000 – 12,000 hours of operations).
- Hydraulic systems (e.g., hydraulic pumps, hydraulic tanks) (replacement rate of 5,000 – 10,000 hours of operations).

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia to increase port throughput from 9M TEU to 40M TEU (~20% CAGR) - SGP and RSGT plan to increase their cargo-handling capacity by 2.5x until 2030, resulting in additional need for spare parts, increasing spend on this category - Regional demand growth due to upcoming projects (e.g., Kuwait port expansion)

Set up a manufacturing plant for maintenance supplies and consumables.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia to grow its rail network by 2.5x (to 13,000 km of track), increase passenger volume by 10x, and increase freight volumes by 8x by 2030, leading to an increase in the usage of maintenance supplies, and therefore increasing the spend on these materials - Regional demand growth due to upcoming projects (e.g., Etihad rail (UAE), Egypt Rail network)

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Absence of local suppliers for high-volume MRO materials
• Targeted components have standardized specifications with cross-industrial applications (i.e., maritime, aviation)
• Export potential of SAR 3 – 4 M annually
• Potential to become supplier of choice for Saudi rail operators, given current global supplier lead-time is eight months (e.g., CRRC, WABTEC)

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to address current market and take advantage of growing demand to establish strong local manufacturing capability.

- Application: In the mining sector, filtration components and machinery are paramount for maintaining product quality and safeguarding equipment against detrimental contaminants. By effectively removing impurities and particulates, these systems contribute to smoother operations.

- Products / Services Targeted: Equipment MRO (Filtration components and machinery).

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Potential for 100% private investment with an opportunity for organic growth or partnerships. - Similar growth observed in neighboring countries, thus opening the filtration market beyond Saudi Arabia.
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Growing need for treated water and for desalinated water to supply surging demand – Saudi Arabia filtration market expected to grow to SAR 375M
• Local manufacturing of filtration equipment in Saudi Arabia around 40% of the total supply volume in the market – presence of assembly activities in Saudi Arabia.

details.description:
- Description: An opportunity exists to develop strong local capability in this area, providing valves and blocks supply for many sectors.

- Application: Valves and blocks are vital for fluid and gas control in piping systems. In mining, valves regulate flow and pressure, aiding substance management, while blocks strategically redirect fluid paths, enhancing system performance and integrity.

- Products / Services Targeted: Equipment MRO (Valves & Blocks).

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - The Saudi market size (2021) is SAR 5.4B growing by 7% annually to become SAR 10.3B by 2030. - Easy access to high growth industrial valves market – GCC projected to grow at 3.1% p.a.
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Giga-projects planned/initiated in Saudi Arabia to drive demand for valves in both industrial and commercial segments over next 10 – 15 years.
• Sector opportunities include catering demand by company as well as contractors in the region.

details.description:
The aviation industry is undergoing a significant transformation, with airlines modernizing their fleets and retiring older aircraft at an accelerating pace.

This has created an opportunity to establish a state-of-the-art aircraft recycling hub dedicated to the aerospace industry with a melting capability to produce raw material and a recycled spare parts facility.

The facility would serve not only local but also regional airlines.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: The airline operators in the region are estimated to experience a demand for around 2,900 new aircraft over the next 20 years, increasing the retirement of older aircrafts The Middle East market is growing at CAGR of 3.3% and is expected to be SAR 800-850M by 2030
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• There is a growing trend towards retiring older aircrafts due to up to 40% higher fuel consumption
• The opportunity also aligns with Saudi Green Initiative by promoting sustainable industrial practices, reducing waste, and cutting carbon emissions.

details.description:
- Specifications:
1. Gate Valve - Air Valve - Butterfly Valve - Ball Valve1 - Control Valve.
2. Setting up a valve manufacturing plant to cater water and wastewater sector requirements across the local and regional markets.

Key products (HS code): 
-Butterfly valve (84818010)
-Gate valves (84818090) 
-Other valves such as air valves, etc.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Valves market is set to grow at 7% CAGR reaching the size of ~ SAR 11.3 Bn by 2030 driven by O&G, construction, and infrastructure expansion plans. - Planned 1,400+ water distribution projects, worth nearly SAR 124 Bn and SAR 11 Bn worth of investments in wastewater reuse expected from National Water Company (2021 – 26). - 3500+ km of additional water transmission lines expected to be added by The Water Transmission and Technologies Company. - MEWA allocated SAR 150 Bn for water projects under five-year capital portfolio of environment, water & agriculture systems. - Projects such as NEOM, the Red Sea Project, Qiddiya Entertainment City, King Abdullah Financial District and Amaala to create significant demand.
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• The Saudi water sector and NWC represent key demand centers for valves . Valves manufacturing is part of the Saudi Arabian National Industrial Strategy.
• Localization of valve manufacturing aimed at 45% by 2030, up from ~18% in 2021.

source_opportunities.normalized_source_title: upvc door and window systems fabrication

cardsData.stat:
SAR 90-110M (USD 24-29.3M)
[For a facility of 100K units per year; excluding land cost]

currentMarketCharacteristicsPoints.point:
• Consolidated local market with three players holding ~60% share; rest addressed by small players and imports, mostly from China and Turkey
• Key local players
• Wintek SA and Fazah Group have capability to locally extrude uPVC profiles with European standards, and Creative Windows Co,, which importing uPVC profiles from Germany
• Local suppliers of input material: Wintek (extrusions), Fazah (extrusions), AGC Obeikan (glass), Uniglass (glass), and Guardian Glass (glass)

details.description:
Establishing one or more uPVC door and window systems fabrication plants to address the local supply gap of 1.4-2.0M units per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Assembly of uPVC profiles, glass panes, and accessories to fabricate the final product 
- Automation of large-scale assembly lines to competitively fulfil large orders
- Inclusion of adjacent capabilities to extrude uPVC profiles

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Cumulative national demand 32M uPVC units for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Opportunity to substitute imports of uPVC doors and windows (~SAR 160M in 2022)
• Abundant availability of uPVC resin in Saudi Arabia from SABIC (through SAPPCO), a key local supplier of uPVC resin with production plants in Riyadh and Dammam
• Large production volumes allowing for automation, resulting in EBITDA margins of ~20% in line with global leaders

details.description:
- Establishing one or more production plants for thermal barrier strips to address the local supply gap of 78-100M meters per annum

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Increasing regulatory requirements toward lowering the u-value (window’s’ insulation measure) - Demand driven by higher standards for energy efficiency and by large aluminum window orders from PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Opportunity to replace imports of thermal barrier strips (~SAR 70M in 2022)
• Export potential to neighboring countries due to lack of regional production
• Glass fiber and polyamide 6.6 locally available in Saudi Arabia
• Local procurement preference in contracts (e.g., price preference, local content consideration in commercial evaluation)
• Current Market
• Market fully supplied through imports
• Key global players include Technoform (Germany) and Dowell (Australia)
• Local suppliers of input materials: SABIC (polyamide 6.6), NOV (glass fiber), and FRP Technology (glass fiber)

details.description:
Establishing one or more door locks manufacturing plants to address the local supply gap of 6.3-8.2M locks per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Focus on production of locks for residential doors – both new doors and after sales/ replacement market; large upcoming local demand for residential doors (~98M units from 2025 to 2040)
- Inclusion of capability to produce the sub-components within the facility (e.g., cylinders, bolts, springs)

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Saudi Arabia demand for door locks driven by a cumulative national demand of ~98M residential door units for the 2025-2040 period from PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Opportunity to replace imports of door locks (~SAR 400M in 2022)
• Export potential to cater to a market demand of more thn SAR 600M (10-12M units) in GCC (excluding Saudi Arabia)
• Cost competitiveness of local production due to lower logistics cost and avoidance of 15% import tariffs
• Local procurement preference in contracts (e.g., price preference, local content consideration in commercial evaluation)

details.description:
Establishing one or more scroll compressors and motors assembly plants (separately) to address the local supply gap of ~5M scroll compressors and ~18M motors per annum used in HVAC systems

Key opportunity characteristics
- Assembly of scroll compressors includes having automation and robotics for mass production
- Motors facility includes having automated assembly lines for 3 types of motors: blower, swing and condenser fan motors

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Cumulative demand of ~86M units scroll compressors and ~288M units of motors in Saudi Arabia for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Opportunity to close gap in HVAC supply chain, as currently all compressors and motors are imported
• Significant potential to expand to other industries with high demand for compressors and motors such as automotive, oil and gas, water desalination and petrochemicals
• Ability to benefit from the “Standard Incentives Program” and receive funding up to 35% of the initial capex (capped at SAR 50M)
• Current Market
• Market fully supplied through imports; no local producer of compressors and motors
• Key global players include Gree (China), Mitsubishi Electric (Japan) and Danfoss (Denmark)

- Saudi Coffee Company has launched its brand ‘Jazean’ with the aim of becoming the leader and global custodian of Arabica coffee production and marketing
- An opportunity exists to enable green coffee import and re-export to key markets to supplement local production and strengthen Saudi Arabia’s role in the international coffee market
- The private sector is expected to localize key capabilities in green coffee import and re-export, including but not limited to developing specialized warehousing, optimizing logistics for bulk coffee handling, and localizing export-oriented processing facilities

details.description:
Establishing one or more wood doors fabrication plants to address the local supply gap of 3.5-5M doors per annum

Key opportunity characteristics
- Processing of wood to produce hollow-core and solid-core doors for residential projects
- Automation of assembly lines to competitively fulfill large orders
- Inclusion of adjacent capabilities in after-sales repair and maintenance services

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Cumulative national demand ~98M residential doors units (~SAR 147B) for the 2025-2040 period, with largest residential doors segment is wood, representing 75%-85% of existing doors - Demand driven by PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Favorable competitive environment due to absence of local at-scale suppliers to fulfill large demand orders
• Potential for horizontal expansion to adjacent wood products (e.g., cumulative demand from 2025 to 2040 for wood cabinetry products from PIF projects > SAR 4B)
• Large production volumes allowing for automation, resulting in EBITDA margins higher than local competition, with estimated EBITDA margin of 9-14% for medium-sized players and less than 5% for small players

details.description:
Badael is a pioneer in enhancing the quality of life through innovative and sustainable solutions. Committed to Saudi Vision 2030, Badael is dedicated to helping one million Saudis quit smoking by 2028.

To support this mission, Badael has launched its flagship product, DZRT, nicotine pouches that offer a less harmful, tobacco-free alternative to help individuals quit smoking.

An opportunity exists to establish a local manufacturing facility for pure nicotine, which would supply both Badael and global markets.

Application
Pure nicotine serves as the core active ingredient in nicotine pouches, delivering a controlled nicotine dose to satisfy cravings without the harmful chemicals found in traditional tobacco products.

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - The global nicotine pouch market is valued at $3.95 billion and is expected to reach $22.95 billion, registering a CAGR of 34.4%. - In Saudi Arabia, the market is currently valued at SAR 900 million and is expected to grow at a CAGR of 30%.
keyGrowthDrivers.title: Key Growth Drivers

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Enhanced focus on Saudi Vision 2030 and the National Tobacco Control Strategy, aimed at improving the quality of life by promoting a smoke-free environment.
• Gain access to the largest market in the Middle East, with a rapidly growing population projected to reach 39.7 million by 2030.
• Limited local supply and the potential to export to regional markets.

details.description:
- Establishing one or more polyether monomer production plants to address the local supply gap of 9,000-12,000 tons per annum
- Focus on producing T-shaped isopentyl polyethylene glycol (TPEG) and methoxy polyethylene glycol (MPEG) monomers to cater to demand driven by PCE producers

keyGrowthDrivers.description: - Cumulative Saudi Arabia polyether monomer demand from concrete admixtures only of ~167,000 tons (~ SAR 1B) for the 2025-2040 period - Demand driven by the need for PCE-based concrete admixtures in PIF Giga-projects, Riyadh growth, Vision 2030 programs, and other real estate developments across Saudi Arabia

strategicBenefitsPoints.point:
• Absence of local production of polyether monomers

short_description.raw:
Description of Investment Opportunity - Description: An opportunity exists to address current market and take advantage of growing demand to establish strong local manufacturing capability.

- Market can be segmented by type into forged grinding media, high chrome cast grinding media, others, and can be segmented by application into chemistry industry, metallurgy industry, cement plant, power plant, others.

- Application: Lubricants are substances used in the mining industry to reduce friction between moving parts and prevent wear and tear.

- Products / Services Targeted: Oil, grease, penetrating lubricants and dry lubricants. Key opportunity characteristics /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 38M (USD 10.1M) /opportunities/icons/riyal.svg SAR 56M (USD 14.9M)
[2023 demand] Strategic Benefits Current Market Characteristics Key Growth Drivers - The global lubricants market size was valued at SAR 446.5 B in 2023 and is projected to be worth SAR 453.6B in 2024 and reach SAR 527.1B by 2032, exhibiting a CAGR of 2.3% during the forecast period. - Saudi Arabia lubricants market size is valued at SAR 5.2B in 2021, growing at a CAGR of 2.05% rate during the forecast period 2022 to 2028. - Highly consolidated market, with top 5 players accounting for more than 90% of the market.

raw_data_json.extracted_description: مزايدة تقديم الخدمات الغذائية والعامة ( مطاعم ومتاجر عامة) إضافة "مزايدة تقديم الخدمات الغذائية والعامة ( مطاعم ومتاجر عامة ) بمباني كليات الجامعة". موعد التقديم : يوم الخميس تاريخ 2024/12/19م موعد نهاية تقديم العطاء : يوم الاربعاء تاريخ 2025/01/22م موعد فتح المظاريف : يوم الخميس 2025/01/23م. قيمة الكراسة: 300 ريال     مميزات الفرصة: 1- مدة العقد لمدة ٣ سنوات الشروط تفتح المظاريف الساعة العاشرة والنصف صباحاً بمكتب سعادة مدير عام الإدارة العامة للشؤون الإدارية والمالية بمبنى الإدارة الرئيسي رقم (3) بالدور الثالث. مراجعة إدارة المشتريات والمناقصات للحصول على كراسة الشروط والمواصفات وسداد القيمة عن طريق البنك (نقداً أو شيك مصدق باسم جامعة الملك فيصل). يشترط شراء الكراسة لتقديم العطاء. يشترط تقديم سند الشراء عند تقديم العطاء. شراء الكراسة وتقديم العطاءات يتم عن طريق إدارة المشتريات بمبنى إدارة الجامعة. للاستفسار: يمكن التواصل مع إدارة الاستثمار وتنمية الموارد أو هاتف ( 0135897755 ) للاطلاع على النسخة العامة من كراسة الشروط و المواصفات الرجاء الضغط على الرابط الأسفل :- كراسة الشروط و المواصفات

source_opportunities.normalized_source_title: momah and ncp launch eoi to municipal food safety labs across five municipalities in saudi arabia

raw_data_json.extracted_description: News Return to Media Center 01/04/2026 Previous Next MOMAH and NCP Launch EOI to Municipal Food Safety Labs Across Five Municipalities in Saudi Arabia Page Image Developing advanced food safety labs to enhance testing, ensure quality, and protect public health in line with Vision 2030. Page Content Riyadh, April 2026 , the Ministry of Municipalities and Housing (MOMAH) and the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), have announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) stage for the Municipal Food Safety Labs Operation Project under a PPP framework (Equip-Operate-Maintain-Transfer) for a contract duration of 5 years, inviting local, regional, and global companies with experience in lab operations to participate and submit their bids. The project scope includes equipping, operating, and maintaining food safety labs across five municipalities, including Hafr Al Batin, Northern Borders, Tabuk, Qassim, and Al Ahsa. The project aims to upgrade lab equipment, expand chemical and microbiological testing capacity for food and water products, ensure testing accuracy to support the lab compliance value chain, and facilitate ongoing knowledge transfer and end-of-contract handover to the respective municipalities. The Municipal Food Safety Labs Operation Project seeks to boost public health and safety standards for the Kingdom's citizens and residents in line with the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030, besides developing the municipal monitoring ecosystem, optimizing food and water testing, and empowering the private sector to run operations as per global best practices. Once completed, the project will enhance food safety in the Kingdom, enable sustainable growth across targeted regions by creating unique investment opportunities for the private sector, and improve the efficiency of government spending through the PPP model, playing a key role in elevating the quality of municipal services being offered to citizens and residents. Local and international investors, financial institutions, and operators are invited to visit the NCP website at www.investors.ncp​.gov.sa for more information about the project and to request the EOI document. Interested investors should submit their EOI by 15 April 2026 at 11:59 PM KSA time.​ ​ Share | Print

raw_data_json.extracted_description: News Return to Media Center 09/06/2024 Previous Next ZATCA, in collaboration with NCP, launch EOI for Water and Sewage Treatment Plants PPP Project at 10 Land Ports Page Image Riyadh, June 2024: Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) Page Content Riyadh, June 2024: Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) phase for Water and Sewage Treatment Plants Project at Land Ports through a Public-Private-Partnership (PPP). The project will be tendered under a Design-Build-Finance-Operate-Maintain-Transfer (DBFOMT) model, with a contract duration of 15 years, including the construction period. The project will be implemented on ten land ports across the Kingdom. These include Al Batha, Salwa, Al Khafji, Al Raqi, Jadidat Arar, Al Hadithah, Halat Ammar, Al Durrah, Al Wadiah, and Empty Quarter. The project encompasses the design, construction, expansion, and refurbishment of plants and related assets, including networks. Additionally, it will include the supervision of the construction activities. In addition to the above, the project involves overseeing the daily operations of the plants and related assets, management of network operations, recording and reporting on operations, and ensuring alternative water and sewage treatment supply in case of interruption. Furthermore, it includes the performance of preventive maintenance for plants, networks, and related assets, cleaning of civil structures and plants, provision of spare parts and replacements, recording and reporting of maintenance, execution of lifecycle replacements and repairs, and monitoring of maintenance activities. ZATCA and NCP invite local and international investors interested in the project to visit the NCP website and review the EOI document. All interested companies should submit their EOI by 30, June 2024 at 3:00 pm KSA time. ​ Share | Print

raw_data_json.extracted_description: News Return to Media Center 11/06/2024 Previous Next ZATCA and NCP Launch RFQ for Power Plant PPP Project at Empty Quarter (Rub'al Khali) Land Port Page Image Zakat, Tax, and Customs Authority (ZATCA), in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), launched the Request for Qualification (RFQ) Page Content Zakat, Tax, and Customs Authority (ZATCA), in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), launched the Request for Qualification (RFQ) phase for the development of a hybrid power plant at the Empty Quarter land port (Rub'al Khali). The project aims to reduce the use of diesel fuel by using renewable energy and ensure long term power supply at the Empty Quarter land port through a Public-Private-Partnership (PPP) in line with the Kingdom's Vision 2030. ZATCA stated that the project will be implemented in partnership with the private sector, under a Design-Build-Finance-Operate-Maintain-Transfer (DBFOMT) contract model for a term of 25 years in addition to the construction period. The project involves designing, developing, operating, and maintaining a power generation facility at the Empty Quarter land port to meet ZATCA's electricity demand and technical specifications. This includes ensuring that the facility operates in accordance with the defined requirements and output specifications, as well as managing power generation and connection to the ZATCA interface point for the specified term of the project. Interested parties can request the RFQ document, by submitting the request form via NCP's website, www.ncp.gov.sa. Furthermore, the submission phase for the RFQ will remain open until July 21, 2024 at 3:00pm KSA time. Share | Print

raw_data_json.extracted_description: News Return to Media Center 12/06/2024 Previous Next Following the approval of a project document by the Council of Ministers offering 14 sports clubs for privatization Page Image Following the approval of a project document by the Council of Ministers offering 14 sports clubs for privatization Page Content MOS in collaboration with NCP, Announces the Start of Second Phase of Sports Clubs Investment and Privatization Project Second Track​​​ Ministry of Sport announced today Wednesday, 3 July 2024, in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), the start of the second phase of the second track in the Sports Clubs Investment and Privatization Project. This occurred subsequent to the Council of Ministers' resolution, which was made on Tuesday, July 2, 2024, to approve the project document for the privatization of 14 teams from various divisions. This also came to continue the project launched by HRH the Crown Prince back in June of last year. The project aims to attain the objectives of the Kingdom's Vision 2030 and to encourage the business sector to take part in the establishment and growth of the sports industry in a manner that would benefit all teams, clubs, players, and fans. In the second phase of the second track, sports clubs at various levels will be made available for privatization to both domestic and foreign investors. The first batch of clubs included six clubs (Al-Zulfi, Al-Nahda, Al-Okhdood, Al-Ansar, Al-Orouba, and Al-Kholoud). Investors can visit the investor portal on the NCP website to apply and get the required information if they would want to invest in the clubs included in the first batch starting from August 2024. Al-Shoulla, Hajar, Al-Najma, Al-Riyadh, Al-Rawda, Jeddah, Al-Taraji, and Al-Sahel are the next eight clubs whose offerings will be completed sequentially later. There were two primary tracks used to initiate the project. The first was granting permission for businesses and development organizations to invest in sports teams in return for a transfer of ownership. There were eight clubs on this track. The second track, which was launched, offered several sports clubs for privatization. The track will now be completed with a second phase, which is offering six clubs for privatization, with the stage being completed by offering other clubs during the coming period, in accordance with the project's strategic plans. The first phase of the track involved registering the interest of local and international entities wishing to invest in sports clubs. This announcement is in line with the efforts made to accomplish the main goals of the club investment and privatization project, which include improving the administrative and financial governance of sports clubs, creating an environment that is conducive to sports investment, and improving the fan experience through the development of infrastructure. The project also demonstrates the Ministry's enthusiasm to be able to help sports teams become financ

raw_data_json.extracted_description: News Return to Media Center 12/06/2024 Previous Next ZATCA, in collaboration with NCP, launch EOI for Residential Buildings PPP Project at Land Ports Page Image Riyadh, June 2024: Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) Page Content Riyadh, June 2024: Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) phase for the Residential Buildings Project at Land Ports through Public-Private-Partnership (PPP). The project will be tendered under a Design-Build-Finance-Operate-Maintain-Transfer (DBFOMT) model, with a contract duration of 23 years, including the construction period. The project will be implemented at nine (9) land ports across the Kingdom. These include Al Batha, Salwa, Al Raqi, Jadidat Arar, Al Hadithah, Halat Ammar, Al Durrah, Al Wadiah, and Empty Quarter. raw_data_json.extracted_description: News Return to Media Center 28/07/2024 Previous Next launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) phase for Driving Schools Monitoring and Test Management project through Public-Private Partnership (PPP) Page Image Riyadh, July 2024: The Ministry of interior (MOI), in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) Page Content Riyadh, July 2024: The Ministry of interior (MOI), in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) phase for Driving Schools Monitoring and Test Management project through Public-Private Partnership (PPP). This project aims to monitor the performance of driving schools and administer driving tests in the Kingdom, with the key objective of enhancing the quality and efficiency of driving tests and raise the standards of driving schools. There are currently more than 69 driving schools throughout the Kingdom. The project will be tendered under an operation and management (O&M) model, with a contract duration of 10 years, including 18 months for the project implementation. The project involves both driving test management and driving school monitoring. It includes operating and managing driving tests, which encompasses, pre-evaluation, theoretical, and practical tests, arranging necessary equipment, preparing tests based on the General Department of Traffic guidelines, and training testing staff, including examiners and assessors. Additionally, it involves developing standards for evaluating driving schools and trainers, conducting on-site evaluations, monitoring performance and compliance with key performance indicators (KPIs). It includes developing action plans for driving schools' improvement and submission of reports to the Ministry of interior and the General department of Traffic. Ministry of Interior and National Center for Privatization & PPP invited local and international investors interested in the project to visit the NCP website and review the EOI document. All interested companies should submit their EOI by 25 August 2024 at 3:00pm KSA time. Share | Print

Page Content ​ ​ Ministry of Sport, in Collaboration with NCP, Launches EOI and RFQ Phase for Acquisition of Al Najma and Al Okhdood Sports Clubs The Ministry of Sport, in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced today, Wednesday, 20 August 2025, the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) and Request for Qualification (RFQ) phase for the acquisition of Al Najma and Al Okhdood Sports Clubs. This initiative forms part of the continued implementation of the Sports Clubs Investment and Privatization Project, aimed at increasing private sector participation in the sports sector in alignment with the goals of Saudi Vision 2030. This follows the announcement made in July, which opened the door for expressions of interest from investors seeking to acquire any of the Saudi sports clubs. The Ministry of Sport and NCP call on all interested local and international investors to visit the NCP website at investors.ncp.gov.sa to review further information and details regarding the RFQ. The deadline for submitting the SOQ is Wednesday 17 September 2025, at 6:00 PM (KSA time). These steps reflect the Ministry of Sport's commitment to achieving the goals of the Sports Clubs Investment and Privatization Project. They aim to enhance private sector participation in the sports industry and advance the development of sports clubs by improving financial and administrative sustainability, ultimately contributing to the growth and prosperity of Saudi sports. Page Content ​ ​ Ministry of Sport, in Collaboration with NCP, Launches EOI and RFQ Phase for Acquisition of Al Najma and Al Okhdood Sports Clubs The Ministry of Sport, in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced today, Wednesday, 20 August 2025, the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) and Request for Qualification (RFQ) phase for the acquisition of Al Najma and Al Okhdood Sports Clubs. This initiative forms part of the continued implementation of the Sports Clubs Investment and Privatization Project, aimed at increasing private sector participation in the sports sector in alignment with the goals of Saudi Vision 2030. This follows the announcement made in July, which opened the door for expressions of interest from investors seeking to acquire any of the Saudi sports clubs. The Ministry of Sport and NCP call on all interested local and international investors to visit the NCP website at investors.ncp.gov.sa to review further information and details regarding the RFQ. The deadline for submitting the SOQ is Wednesday 17 September 2025, at 6:00 PM (KSA time). These steps reflect the Ministry of Sport's commitment to achieving the goals of the Sports Clubs Investment and Privatization Project. They aim to enhance private sector participation in the sports industry and advance the development of sports clubs by improving financial and administrative sustainability, ultimately contributing to the growth and prosperity of Saudi sports. source_opportunities.normalized_source_title: saudi broadcasting authority national center for privatization ppp launch expression of interest phase for television radio towers infrastructure ppp project in 143 locations

raw_data_json.extracted_description: News Return to Media Center 06/09/2024 Previous Next Saudi Broadcasting Authority, National Center for Privatization & PPP Launch Expression of Interest Phase for Television & Radio Towers Infrastructure PPP Project in 143 Locations Page Image ​​The Saudi Broadcasting Authority (SBA), in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) Page Content ​​ The Saudi Broadcasting Authority (SBA), in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) phase for the Television & Radio Towers Infrastructure PPP project to develop and operate the SBA towers infrastructure by the private sector under a Rehabilitate-Finance-Operate-Maintain-Transfer (RFOMT) contract model with a 25 years contract. The project is considered one of the Public-Private-Partnership (PPP) projects aimed to enhance the performance of the TV and radio towers infrastructure for the media sector in the Kingdom at 143 locations and increasing the number of TV and radio channels by qualifying and upgrading all TV sites from (DVB-T/Analogue) to (DVB-T2), with the aim of increasing the number of high-quality channels, and maintaining and operating the TV and radio towers infrastructure. SBA and NCP invited investors and interested parties to review the EOI document - containing project information - by visiting the NCP website, ( www.ncp.gov.sa ), noting that the EOI submission phase will end on 21 July, 2024, at 3:00 PM KSA time. Share | Print

source_opportunities.normalized_source_title: zatca and ncp launch eoi and rfq for development and operations of customs warehouses project at 38 points of entry

raw_data_json.extracted_description: News Return to Media Center 06/10/2024 Previous Next ZATCA and NCP Launch EOI and RFQ for Development and Operations of Customs Warehouses Project at 38 Points of Entry Page Image Riyadh, October 2024: Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), Page Content Riyadh, October 2024: Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) and Request for Qualification (RFQ) phase for Development and Operations of Customs Warehouses Project at 38 Points of Entry (PoEs) across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The project will be tendered under a Design-Build-Finance-Maintain-Operate-Transfer (DBFMOT) model, with a contract duration of 15 years, including the construction period. The project involves the design, construction and maintenance of 13 warehouses: 12 new facilities and renovation of one existing warehouse. Operational responsibilities will cover all new and existing warehouses across 38 PoEs. This will include loading and off-loading goods in the warehouses, operating forklifts, cranes, and trucks, as well as providing cleaning services. Additionally, the project encompasses the provision of new equipment for all 38 warehouses. ZATCA and NCP invite local and international investors interested in the project to visit the NCP website at www.ncp.gov.sa to learn more about the project and request the RFQ document. All interested companies should submit their SOQ by November 14, 2024 at 3:00 pm KSA time. Share | Print

raw_data_json.extracted_description: News Return to Media Center 07/10/2024 Previous Next RGA and NCP Launch EOI for Jeddah - Makkah Direct Highway Project Page Image Riyadh, October 2024: Following the approval of the Supervisory Committee for Privatization in the Transport and Logistic Services Page Content Riyadh, October 2024: Following the approval of the Supervisory Committee for Privatization in the Transport and Logistic Services, chaired by H.E. Eng. Saleh bin Nasser Al-Jasser, Minister of Transport and Logistics Services and Chairman of the Roads General Authority (RGA), the RGA, in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) phase for the Jeddah-Makkah Direct Highway project and its associated Motorway Services Areas (MSAs). The tender aims to attract the best in-class road construction companies, to be delivered to the highest standards of traffic safety and quality, in line with the Roads Strategy and the National Transport and Logistics Strategy (NTLS). RGA highlighted that the project will be executed through a public-private partnership (PPP) model, involving an Operations and Maintenance (O&M) contract for the Jeddah-Makkah Highway, along with a Design, Build, Finance, Operate, and Maintain (DBFOM) contract for new service areas on both sides of the highway, with a contract term of 10 years. It aims to operate and maintain the Jeddah-Makkah Direct Road, which consists of four lanes in each direction, spanning a distance of 64 kilometers, and includes six intersections, one camel crossing, and five vehicle overpasses. The project also includes the construction, operation, and maintenance of four service areas on both sides of the road. The Authority stated that the road will significantly serve pilgrims and Umrah performers heading to Makkah, as it is one of the shortest routes connecting Jeddah to the Holy City, taking just 35 minutes. The road will also contribute to supporting logistics and tourism in the region and will help maintain the Kingdom’s standing on the Global Connectivity Index. RGA and NCP invite local and international investors interested in road construction to learn about the project by visiting the NCP website and reviewing the EOI document on the project page. All interested companies should submit their EOI by October 24, 2024 at 3:00pm KSA time. -END- Share | Print

raw_data_json.extracted_description: News Return to Media Center 02/12/2024 Previous Next MATARAT Holding, in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP) announce the launch of Expression of Interest (EOI) phase for the New Taif International Airport Page Image Expression of Interest (EOI) for the new Taif International Airport project. Page Content ​ Riyadh, December 2024: MATARAT Holding, in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP) is pleased to announce the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) for the new Taif International Airport project. This invitation is open to interested private sector entities in a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model under a Build-Transfer-Operate (BTO) contract for a period of 30 years inclusive of the construction period. This Project is in line with Vision 2030's goals, which aims to enhance the growth of the aviation sector in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Through the National Transport and Logistics Strategy and the National Aviation Strategy, the Kingdom seeks to strengthen its position among the leading nations as a global logistics hub connecting three continents. The new Taif International Airport will be located 21 km southeast of the existing Taif Airport, with a capacity to accommodate 2.5 million passengers by 2030. The Project scope includes (BTO) model of the new airport. The proposed design features a runway with a full-length-parallel taxiway, that connects to a single commercial apron. The new Taif International Airport will include a well-equipped commercial passenger terminal building aligned with the airport's projected capacity and demand, along with facility buildings, utility networks, car parks, and access roads that enable the standard operation of the airport. The project includes additional expansions to meet future subsystem requirements. The new Taif International Airport is expected to meet the projected increase in demand by 2055. It is also expected to meet the needs of Umrah pilgrims as a viable alternative within the region's multi-airport system. This system includes King Abdulaziz Airport in Jeddah, Prince Mohammed bin Abdulaziz Airport in Madinah, and Prince Abdulmohsen bin Abdulaziz Airport in Yanbu. The new Taif International Airport will contribute to the economic development of Taif city and its surrounding areas, in line with the National Aviation Strategy, as a highly efficient airport offering a top-quality passenger experience MATARAT Holding and NCP invite interested investors to review the EOI document containing project information by visiting the NCP's website (www.ncp.gov.sa). The deadline for submission of EOIs is January 10 2025, at 3:00 p.m. KSA time.​​ ​ Share | Print

Through the National Transport and Logistics Strategy and the National Aviation Strategy, the Kingdom seeks to strengthen its position among the leading nations as a global logistics hub connecting three continents. The new Taif International Airport will be located 21 km southeast of the existing Taif Airport, with a capacity to accommodate 2.5 million passengers by 2030. The Project scope includes (BTO) model of the new airport. The proposed design features a runway with a full-length-parallel taxiway, that connects to a single commercial apron. The new Taif International Airport will include a well-equipped commercial passenger terminal building aligned with the airport's projected capacity and demand, along with facility buildings, utility networks, car parks, and access roads that enable the standard operation of the airport. The project includes additional expansions to meet future subsystem requirements. The new Taif International Airport is expected to meet the projected increase in demand by 2055. It is also expected to meet the needs of Umrah pilgrims as a viable alternative within the region's multi-airport system. This system includes King Abdulaziz Airport in Jeddah, Prince Mohammed bin Abdulaziz Airport in Madinah, and Prince Abdulmohsen bin Abdulaziz Airport in Yanbu. raw_data_json.extracted_description: News Return to Media Center 20/01/2025 Previous Next PPP Opportunities Unveiled: Two Iconic Mixed-Use Developments in Al Madinah Page Image launch of the Expressions of Interest (EOI) and Request for Qualification (RFQ) phase for two transformative real estate projects in Al Madinah Al Munawarah: Joint Development Project in Sikkah Al Hadid, and Joint Development Project in Dhul Hulaifah. Page Content ​ Riyadh, January 2025: Al Madinah Regional Municipality, in collaboration with the Ministry of Municipalities and Housing (MOMAH) and the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), is pleased to announce the launch of the Expressions of Interest (EOI) and Request for Qualification (RFQ) phase for two transformative real estate projects in Al Madinah Al Munawarah: Joint Development Project in Sikkah Al Hadid, and Joint Development Project in Dhul Hulaifah. These projects will be executed under a Public-Private Partnerships (PPP) model through Build-Own-Operate-Transfer (BOOT) contracts with a duration of 30 years. Sikkah Al Hadid project will transform an 84,657-square-meter government-owned site west of Al Madinah Al Munawarah into an integrated mixed-use facility. The site's strategic location and flexible zoning, permitting buildings up to 20 floors, combined with excellent road network connectivity, ensure easy access for residents and visitors. The development will also synergize with adjacent residential projects by the National Housing Company (NHC), supporting the surrounding community while catering to a growing population within a 5-kilometer radius. Key components include a state-of-the-art, four-story medical center with up to 200 beds, outpatient clinics, and multi-specialty services. Complementing these healthcare facilities is a shopping mall featuring diverse retail options, including fashion stores, food and beverage outlets, and entertainment venues. Dhul Hulaifah project is set to transform a 30,112-square-meter government-owned site into a mixed-use development just 6 kilometers from the Prophet's Mosque. This project leverages its picturesque surroundings, excellent connectivity, and proximity to religious landmarks, making it an ideal destination for residents and visitors. The development will feature a four-star hotel integrated with retail spaces and healthcare clinics, offering a unique blend of hospitality and essential services. Pedestrian-friendly retail areas will provide shopping, dining, and leisure options. Additionally, the project includes outpatient clinics offering specialized medical care, diagnostic services, a pharmacy, and a dedicated parking facility to ensure convenient access for all users. Local and international investors are invited to visit the NCP website at (investors.ncp.gov.sa​) for more information about these projects and to request the RFQ document. Interested investors should submit their Statement of Qualification (SOQ) by 2 March, 2025 at 11:59 pm KSA time. ​ ​ ​ Share | Print

full_description.canonical_label: News Return to Media Center 20/01/2025 Previous Next PPP Opportunities Unveiled: Two Iconic Mixed-Use Developments in Al Madinah Page Image launch of the Expressions of Interest (EOI) and Request for Qualification (RFQ) phase for two transformative real estate projects in Al Madinah Al Munawarah: Joint Development Project in Sikkah Al Hadid, and Joint Development Project in Dhul Hulaifah. Page Content Riyadh, January 2025: Al Madinah Regional Municipality, in collaboration with the Ministry of Municipalities and Housing (MOMAH) and the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), is pleased to announce the launch of the Expressions of Interest (EOI) and Request for Qualification (RFQ) phase for two transformative real estate projects in Al Madinah Al Munawarah: Joint Development Project in Sikkah Al Hadid, and Joint Development Project in Dhul Hulaifah. These projects will be executed under a Public-Private Partnerships (PPP) model through Build-Own-Operate-Transfer (BOOT) contracts with a duration of 30 years. Sikkah Al Hadid project will transform an 84,657-square-meter government-owned site west of Al Madinah Al Munawarah into an integrated mixed-use facility. The site's strategic location and flexible zoning, permitting buildings up to 20 floors, combined with excellent road network connectivity, ensure easy access for residents and visitors. The development will also synergize with adjacent residential projects by the National Housing Company (NHC), supporting the surrounding community while catering to a growing population within a 5-kilometer radius. Key components include a state-of-the-art, four-story medical center with up to 200 beds, outpatient clinics, and multi-specialty services. Complementing these healthcare facilities is a shopping mall featuring diverse retail options, including fashion stores, food and beverage outlets, and entertainment venues. Dhul Hulaifah project is set to transform a 30,112-square-meter government-owned site into a mixed-use development just 6 kilometers from the Prophet's Mosque. This project leverages its picturesque surroundings, excellent connectivity, and proximity to religious landmarks, making it an ideal destination for residents and visitors. The development will feature a four-star hotel integrated with retail spaces and healthcare clinics, offering a unique blend of hospitality and essential services. Pedestrian-friendly retail areas will provide shopping, dining, and leisure options. Additionally, the project includes outpatient clinics offering specialized medical care, diagnostic services, a pharmacy, and a dedicated parking facility to ensure convenient access for all users. Local and international investors are invited to visit the NCP website at (investors.ncp.gov.sa) for more information about these projects and to request the RFQ document. Interested investors should submit their Statement of Qualification (SOQ) by 2 March, 2025 at 11:59 pm KSA time. Share | Print
